| | Hi, Peter! Julie Jacobs here. As you may know, my husband Matt is running for Congress in California’s 26th district. And since we’re **less than one month away from the June 7 Primary Election**(mail-in ballots start going out this week), I wanted to share some of the reasons why I believe my husband is the right man for the job. **Matt cares deeply about this community.** Matt was born and raised in this community. This is our home – where we’re raising our three children. Matt understands this community and cares deeply about it. **In Congress, he’ll fight to make sure it’s a place where our families and businesses can grow and thrive. **
---
[**HELP MATT FIGHT**](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=e731247e009d4ea696c87fa4ed182c78&_e=fAdvAn3Dy4YtVFSOTIQSkh7DGy2768-2Zoa8TBBKCujeFsim5AJFxKDPSZrmOrf_6wdCf62kET9mwLlUyUEq6QAG-wfuhaxMiQYorRWzWlUt0gaEGVomderIJB8C2wUy4iJDdaUo1rWCDToCKT2aMCDGNR4N1tlTybnRzgzoiPNywNftJACmUnayzk7kRWJqv3tjLHFmeXpST8O-WUBx0e0icMxu3ea0jw_uZrOdlqXVgrqIw-MKzNTO3zKhFpfiblPJpxNBxYzPmAtbTgqc5TJmMWX-CcDgoYUyPIizTwCeZin6_bCcpYWRdUJCSzIaiCWN-qsxrDYFSsuesNJVXkQ5DGCRyoim1XoCOmLD6w3ePjGLF_6itcKNfzCNtgTV9qPvMUNNXxgi58ZLpZDX-LolE6_4EWJOGeU8XN8l5IaA0XZjE79ItZRVmlTNaAob)

That’s why he devoted his career to serving this country as a Federal Prosecutor. **We deserve a Congressman, like my husband, who believes in the greatness of this country.**

Primary Day is just 7 days from today and I need to know that you support me. Would you clarify whether you do or not right now? We’re in the final leg of our Primary Election campaign to defeat Pelosi loyalist and career politician, Congressman Peter DeFazio in Oregon’s 4th District. | [](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=c8420805645b44b29395dec107d646ec&_e=ABnaWo0M2YxrWnRauYYQigu0_MkvmxPW_gh0GlXx2iywgvRhpTLSK8rrOE6avkOXlLF_T3MRmpkX-Lb-cNz11dSmTLKA8-4q4dpvZ8-mrEhpysoGakV_yp_41YzOpfQNTtfiTx3_7KJp54TcuBdxbvjcStDUZ5mnaNZj3zN1X8UibB_t9thQ_vaW_MdJdxIZSN6vX6CBvYGAeJU9N1NqLYHsgDLQNxPyapQSliIL_XUGZzXVWf2H-t43_VSWpSCO4Hx0-k5UTOUefNiPQ4IqAPUsjhGdk4vJPTbZhnZnWFttNNBt8x9tVbQYTH1uTTi0gRcFSdMmZ40et8E3v_mxlIkIDeSVDFuHT3adiB0WCnjxYKXlxYSwS0jv-5mE5i9PRgdpgm-WUWBXoMNNkZJ8zBD2wcJhBHhds5vSxgykj21cNm5K47QhwJE959W-ydRfW62hhTr1rTrni-Miu2sFUu0Q_aTjHu8w1lT2PFhqRBMHx3n04ITwaOf0zQj72-fJLVoen8pSGVLv8zuIuzcTvWCvvGrwL6i4zQAZ4paeB7qXn8qWyvJweAHvZ1Gszdjhp7a_q8VZtZhOSc6Ts158SA%3D%3D)
---

Peter,

Last week I sent this email out asking for your personal endorsement ahead of my primary - **next Tuesday.** So far, the response has left me a bit disheartened; only 226 people have offered their personal endorsement. I'm resending the original email to see if I can encourage a few more of you to signal your support for me today.

As you know, I challenged a career politician in 2020 who has been in D.C. since 1986. I narrowly lost that race – **by just about 5 points** – after Nancy Pelosi spent more than $5 million on defense.

Now, Peter DeFazio is calling it quits and has endorsed the Oregon Labor Commissioner to replace him in D.C.

Over the last several months we’ve seen a groundswell of support from every corner of the country. From Republican leaders in Washington, D.C., to folks in Oregon’s 4th district, t**o the more than 9,000 conservatives who have made a contribution to help me flip this seat Republican** for the first time since 1975.

The Republican primary on May 17th is fast approaching, and it’s the goal of my campaign to build as much momentum as we can before then. I'm hoping to get 1,000 conservatives to personally endorse my campaign before May 17th (Primary Day). **Would you do me the honor of signaling your endorsement of my candidacy today?**

[](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=c8420805645b44b29395dec107d646ec&_e=ABnaWo0M2YxrWnRauYYQigu0_MkvmxPW_gh0GlXx2iywgvRhpTLSK8rrOE6avkOXlLF_T3MRmpkX-Lb-cNz11dSmTLKA8-4q4dpvZ8-mrEhpysoGakV_yp_41YzOpfQNTtfiTx3_7KJp54TcuBdxbvjcStDUZ5mnaNZj3zN1X8UibB_t9thQ_vaW_MdJdxIZSN6vX6CBvYGAeJU9N1NqLYHsgDLQNxPyapQSliIL_XUGZzXVWf2H-t43_VSWpSCO4Hx0-k5UTOUefNiPQ4IqAPUsjhGdk4vJPTbZhnZnWFttNNBt8x9tVbQYTH1uTTi0gRcFSdMmZ40et8E3v_mxlIkIDeSVDFuHT3adiB0WCnjxYKXlxYSwS0jv-5mE5i9PdBKYuMqfj4EfP_F6MqerrpWCCxGKqjl3hgQD-tySzOFGNtWv-OIRbdwMO4UkWYBxg0qbyt2cjUbTtOpN6tLNcP56rude5UaALXl-3Yl3Ee_U9Hr08t2M8EkAHoflijM7mDn2uZEKNKOAyn2jBcPNdAMhvBRQizcMrya3jF3iNcULdOfWKiTzqwUE0Nx2Yr_2c4pEDEUhre68HcqzhDRRYg%3D%3D)

Beating my new opponent in this open race is not going to be easy, especially since she’s going to try and paint me as an out of touch radical right Republican. **She has the backing of not only the Democrat incumbent, but the entire Democrat establishment.**

Not from Oregon? Let me tell you why you should pay attention to this race.
* Donald Trump only narrowly lost my district – **by LESS THAN 1/10 percent in 2016**

* If we flip this seat, it’s a good sign that Republicans will take back the House.

**Kelly Schulz For Governor Campaign** **Announces High Six-Figure Media Buy**

---
**ANNAPOLIS, MD** — Today, the Kelly Schulz for Governor campaign announced the launch of a high six-figure media buy in the Baltimore and Washington D.C. markets. The buy consists of spending on broadcast, cable, radio, and digital platforms.

A variety of ads touting Schulz's background and policies as well as those holding others accountable for their actions will be featured in the coming weeks and months, as the campaign will remain on the airwaves until the primary election in July. The length of the media buy is demonstrative of the enthusiasm the Schulz campaign is receiving, highlighted by historic fundraising numbers.

The first ad which will be a part of the media buy is the previously released “Parental Rights.” This ad highlights Kelly Schulz’s Parental Bill of Rights, her commitment to ensuring that Maryland parents are empowered and that all children have the opportunity to receive a world-class education.

"Our campaign is excited to make this significant investment which will continue to introduce Kelly Schulz and her plans for Maryland to voters across the state,” said **campaign manager Hunter Mullins**. “By the time we enter the general election, Marylanders will be fully aware of her vision for a safe, steady, and prosperous future for all Marylanders."

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson:Hello,I feel like our culture has forgotten-or ignored-some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human.**As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. Team,
We have some concerning news. The Cook Political Report [https://www.cookpolitical.com/ratings/house-race-ratings] recently moved eight House races across the country in the Republicans' favor. This includes three Democratic incumbents whose races have been moved from “lean democratic” to “toss up.”
The main takeaway from this new reporting? No Democrat currently representing a district won by Trump – or narrowly won by Biden – is safe. And, districts that have been historically swing districts are moving to the right.
Elissa also finds herself in one of these “toss up” districts – and if this trend is any indicator, the results in MI-07 are going to be close. Elissa’s the only Democrat left in the House who won in a district carried by Romney in 2012, Trump in 2016, and Trump again in 2020 – making her seat one of the top targets for those looking to flip the House.
Just what’s at stake if these swing districts flip? The folks who currently represent them are the representatives in Congress who are willing to compromise and reach across the aisle to deliver results. The ones who keep their heads down and do the hard work of legislating. Replacing them with more extreme folks will only make Congress more polarized. In short, it will increase the vitriol and gridlock people already can’t stand in politics.

| | Hey Peter, Josh here, with some key updates from the campaign: By now, you've probably heard that **the New York Court of Appeals has thrown out the previously set Congressional maps and delayed the primary election two months to August 23rd.** This has campaigns and candidates across New York scrambling to figure out how to navigate the new political situation. I'm more determined than ever to defeat him. **You see, during my time in the Iowa State House, I fought tooth and nail against attempts to take away our right to choose, our right to health care and our right to reproductive freedom.**

Patty needs your help.
#
Peter,

Yesterday, Patty emailed about the crucial Women’s Health Protection Act vote happening in the Senate.

That vote happens in just a few hours.

We still need more voices speaking out in favor of the Senate protecting _Roe v. Wade_ , so please: **[add your name now to safeguard the right to abortion.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45174354/344793076/-1065973450?ms=pm_em_220511_1&refcode=pm_em_220511_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDBiMDY4MS0yZWQxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w5sazp39r6cKPCmU_3a-pIFQtbgRMYKvqxZrGOwSqTs=&emci=13381972-b7d0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=740b0681-2ed1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=13116610)**

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **Patty Murray**
Date: Tuesday, May 10, 2022
Subject: Add your name: codify Roe v. Wade now

Peter,

Given the leaked Supreme Court opinion potentially overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , it’s more important than ever for the Senate to codify the right to abortion by passing the Women’s Health Protection Act.

clean_body: The right of the people to keep and bear Arms, shall not be infringed. | | | | == Peter, If you've ever met me, you know that I'll protect the Second Amendment until the day I die. I've put my life on the line to defend the freedoms we have as Americans, and I'd gladly lay down my life to ensure that the American people can express their God-given rights. As Americans, God gave us the right to protect ourselves and our families from all threats, both foreign and domestic. We'll never give up our ability to defend our rights. I believe that all Americans should have the right to bear arms. In Congress, I'll fight day and night to make sure that we protect that right from politicians who want to strip law-abiding citizens from owning firearms. As your Congressman, I'll put forward legislation to end the unacceptable overreach of Red Flag laws. The government should never have the ability to take away our rights based on pure speculation. I'll also work tirelessly to make sure that law-abiding Americans have the right to carry a concealed weapon in any state across this great nation, just as our founders intended. Every American has the right to defend themselves, and a ban on responsible citizens' ability to carry a firearm makes our communities less safe. If you feel the same way as I do, then join me in my fight to send a true conservative to Congress. == | == | == | == | == | == Thank you, == Kevin Kocina Conservative for Congress Minnesota's First District == == If you would like to donate by mail, please send your contribution to: Kocina For Congress P.O. Peter, I grew up on a farm in southern Minnesota where hunting was part of our fabric. My father always left rows of corn unharvested for pheasant habitat and hunting, and we regularly welcomed hunters to our farm, Old Acres. Later in life, my two brothers-in-law allowed me to tag along and I grew to appreciate the experience of an early morning hunt. As an attorney for 25 years in Albert Lea, I have had the honor of working with individuals who purchase land for habitat restoration and hunting use. I also work intimately with many farmers, the original conservationists, in establishing habitat through voluntary buffer strips and other strategic set-aside programs. One of my proudest professional experiences was my work with our local watershed district in the establishment of the Juglans Woods AMA, a 257-acre parcel that preserved and provided public access for hunting, fishing, hiking, and nature enjoyment. I was involved from the ground level in obtaining the funding for this project, identifying, negotiating, and closing on the land purchases with landowners, and coordinating with the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources. In addition, I was twice named as a statewide attorney of the year for my work in helping my local Albert Lea community first stabilize the upstream runoff and then clean up and restore Fountain Lake. This process involved multiple years of work to first obtain funding and then “jostling” with the Department of Natural Resources in obtaining the permit for lake dredging and restoration. These hard-fought battles are now showing real dividends in habitat and clean water restoration. **My commitment to hunting and habitat preservation will not waiver when I go to Congress. Some candidates talk about this issue, I’m proud of my record of real accomplishment.** As a conservative, homegrown and hardworking candidate, I would be honored to earn your vote in the Special Primary Election on May 24. [Early voting](https://d2p4X504.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/OR+113/d2p4X504/VVJRbS4J60PdW5KPYPZ7hSsKhW95j2m74JYD_BN6J4pZ73q90JV1-WJV7CgG8gW5R73X98nTG5CW5K2tGk848mFKN6ttVc7nFFwGW2S7_Wd3_CPkxW7RMZST834GWLW1-CGzT4RnytXW2qmKww5RKpB4W240FSX22hLWMW6Nmggw5gmbWdN4lpK09J8zT2V_ZNJS4CnFDFW4dfncg2LS35KW2XV3Bj75MRkHN4btkSzfpcGLW70jVsv5hygtxW166xyb45ZylHW5Yy7zJ4V_G_9W4k_R9v5vN6qZW5Fzzgc6N9kzkW5N9KRs2YrglPW18Rvq54G1pSWW4Xmfkd6jdBYpW4c08X299SZ0PW1JGtYr7qCtXDW4jyh2N7KVZQgW68tQ_Q5MW66FW7dLchr7PYWX-W3D1DNL6-9pnf32991) is now open. clean_body: I grew up on a farm in southern Minnesota where hunting was part of our fabric. | | | | | ---|---|--- Peter, I grew up on a farm in southern Minnesota where hunting was part of our fabric. My father always left rows of corn unharvested for pheasant habitat and hunting, and we regularly welcomed hunters to our farm, Old Acres. Later in life, my two brothers-in-law allowed me to tag along and I grew to appreciate the experience of an early morning hunt. As an attorney for 25 years in Albert Lea, I have had the honor of working with individuals who purchase land for habitat restoration and hunting use. I also work intimately with many farmers, the original conservationists, in establishing habitat through voluntary buffer strips and other strategic set-aside programs. One of my proudest professional experiences was my work with our local watershed district in the establishment of the Juglans Woods AMA, a 257-acre parcel that preserved and provided public access for hunting, fishing, hiking, and nature enjoyment. I was involved from the ground level in obtaining the funding for this project, identifying, negotiating, and closing on the land purchases with landowners, and coordinating with the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources. In addition, I was twice named as a statewide attorney of the year for my work in helping my local Albert Lea community first stabilize the upstream runoff and then clean up and restore Fountain Lake. This process involved multiple years of work to first obtain funding and then “jostling” with the Department of Natural Resources in obtaining the permit for lake dredging and restoration. These hard-fought battles are now showing real dividends in habitat and clean water restoration. My commitment to hunting and habitat preservation will not waiver when I go to Congress. Some candidates talk about this issue, I’m proud of my record of real accomplishment. As a conservative, homegrown and hardworking candidate, I would be honored to earn your vote in the Special Primary Election on May 24. is now open. The future of Roe v. Wade is hanging in the balance.
#
This is urgent, Peter.
According to a leaked Supreme Court draft opinion, _Roe v. Wade_ – and protection of reproductive rights at the federal level – could be in imminent danger.
This moment demands action – we must defend reproductive freedom.
I’m joining my fellow Democrats in the Senate in supporting the Women’s Health Protection Act, because I believe strongly that the right to reproductive care is one that must be protected. So today, I’m asking:
**[Will you add your name to my petition now in support of the Women’s Health Protection Act?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45181620/344822636/-889070537?ms=dd_em_220511_1&refcode=dd_em_220511_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTgxOGIwOS0zYWQxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tVWPsQLXIk3nAguMt4ZEVTRQAash7CgVmZpnAcHoG-k=&emci=7d00c4e6-32d1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=8e818b09-3ad1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2727974)**
These decisions are deeply personal, and everyone should be able to make them without the interference of politicians. But this Supreme Court draft opinion and the constant attacks by extreme Republicans stand to endanger reproductive care across the country.
**I’m standing up for reproductive rights – and I hope you’re with me.**
**[Sign on now if you support protecting abortion access and codifying _Roe_.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45181621/344822637/-889070537?ms=dd_em_220511_1&refcode=dd_em_220511_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTgxOGIwOS0zYWQxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tVWPsQLXIk3nAguMt4ZEVTRQAash7CgVmZpnAcHoG-k=&emci=7d00c4e6-32d1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=8e818b09-3ad1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2727974)**

But this Supreme Court draft opinion and the constant attacks by extreme Republicans stand to endanger reproductive care across the country. | | Dear Fellow American, Young people today grow up being told that their perception of reality is a matter of perspective. Recently, they are even told that women can choose to be men and men women. This denial of objective reality--including a denial of an objective good--is destructive of proper education, of religious faith, and of free government. Largely as an antidote to this destructive force, Hillsdale College is releasing its latest free online course,**“C.S. Lewis on Christianity.”** Taught by Michael Ward, a visiting distinguished fellow at Hillsdale and a professor of theology at Oxford University, this seven-lecture course covers Lewis’s philosophical defense of an objective good and his demonstration of its fulfillment in Christianity. **I am writing today to ask if you would consider****pre-registering for this free online course. You can do so at this secure link:** ** ** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/cs-lewis-christianity-preregister/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61952%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ude7N0Sbc2UuKLXx4NUjYg&sysid=1)** ** ** **After pre-registering for****“C.S. Lewis on Christianity,” please help us****meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on May 16 to promote this new online course effectively, especially to young people.** ** ** Hillsdale produces its free online courses, as it does all its work, while refusing to accept government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. We are entirely dependent on private donations. With your tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of young people in this new free online course and expand Hillsdale’s other outreach efforts. Thank you for your friendship and support. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

> _We thought you might want to see this special message from our friends at the new Republican Accountability PAC._
Friend,

Primary season is well underway, and the Pennsylvania primaries are fast approaching. While Pennsylvania’s GOP Senate primary is getting a ton of media attention with Trump’s endorsement of pseudoscientist and TV personality Dr. Mehmet Oz, the GOP candidates for governor have gotten much less attention. One candidate for governor, State Senator Doug Mastriano, is an obvious choice for this week’s Threat to Democracy of the Week. Let me tell you why.
---
---
## **Who is Doug Mastriano?**
Mastriano is currently a Pennsylvania state senator, representing the area around Gettysburg. In his 2019 campaign for state senate, he [shared](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VWMQYT8PqG4fW5D0Dcb99VZrZW8mS6hr4JYMhDN5GS5RN5nKvJV3Zsc37CgFkwW398hYd6vdGrYW5Zc2J96CcP7YTzf2r1qNKWPW3nKT_H69pFnQN71nwD18HvMDW7pX1q18QSz7NW90T4gj1GGM5sN14MjmT9QMpCW4zZH3z81LFp5W83-2JJ2JDX2pW2SKw6Z8zF1p9W2MNscH3HBcvpW6kk2tj7_cFW6W5R2Kzc8j-DV8W4m-02B5bzcxXVFV0bF2_SsVVW8FzpH62jBBzpW1PH3LL60c9BKW20TTVL4MK1d5N5jD_dXZBZTdW75NDy624b8TvW8ZkZ5R35gMNHVg0FJq8W1ggzVZCLxc7P-8qkW7PWzf91TSx6-W5wz-nv4Vq3-zW3RNrYF2hCrgnN51lv8fB78y6W8cpS-W5vDC41W6rh1fF6J9vsrN8ybpktlvn1RW3_pgtx47-dhRW71bCP79hhtYJW6pPTq420NKYdN5nSGHyJ2q6JW4Kgv8Y6FRmMr38sC1) conspiracy theories about Muslims on Facebook. He was also a frequent critic of Pennsylvania’s COVID-19 restrictions and joined rallies protesting them outside the State Capitol at the peak of the pandemic. Mastriano’s fondness for conspiracy theories doesn’t stop there.
## **Why is he a threat to democracy?**
Mastriano was one of the thousands of people who came to Washington to protest the certification of the 2020 election. His campaign spent [thousands of dollars](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VWMQYT8PqG4fW5D0Dcb99VZrZW8mS6hr4JYMhDN5GS5Tf3q90_V1-WJV7CgHtRW97VvHV3Xs1ztW42Sh2W7xF8ZrN5fy7hnh5ndSV61NCF66Z8rgVq1C9l15c_6TW7bXYJn4P_F6zW6SPqrS4WqnRyW7fVJqw4kpTX7W3qzZdN3bzNFKN3NN7rYR0GdzW8L23LM4DChCbW8zMyWr7mN3pRW26y4mL7WScy2W2yK5T38MP57yV9n1v73zYpbbW3hs6fV72Xdj4W6p6VCL7WQ7GRW24bCS044h0C_W1NgRvp7sgfTLW80vkC41YZJN-MhcD0kzsDksN3fj40C5ylfXW3l6nbK6hQdJLW4htH787dGYjdW7XgQXv1sc7SmW2sGfbq7MGzRTW4b05QF2tnDgxW4gm71M2Nr6xQW66Jjkv5Ct9GHW3z65Nv44W3jZ3pR51) on buses bringing people to the Capitol, and [there’s video showing him passing through the breached barricade when the Capitol was stormed.](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VWMQYT8PqG4fW5D0Dcb99VZrZW8mS6hr4JYMhDN5GS5Tf3q90_V1-WJV7CgPb2W7GF3nw9bgqC8N8qgvHWZKcJGW6tN7nG6_CVthW7QD_mt3smJ9nW50j5yt92hzSZW80sDps9cC-NrW23gcyk1-LdDrW5Lbj7C1B5zLqW1-l7ZW3xvlDDW8D2PVN4r6bS0W340Xw_3VM5cZW8HPlLZ8SsXjPVYpxlM6lG-hhW1WNznb7dD0GsVD63hV2gv2VWW84ZKcd1m-fzhW30Z2Q05MXkn9W27N7N_9cZm18VcjZDs18nWg5W55h1PY2mHyS4W6BDV-96Zg2ssW5gZs8510q9cpN4yV6TxChC-hN240CJctXgsTVc2RrV6ptGwwW44Kt-F5_nJXNW58vKby6L-cL0W2Jw_l_6RYM7SW1zqP4Y7jK12TW29Gv5w6Kv3_Q35k31)
If that alone wasn’t disqualifying, Mastriano also appears to have sympathy for the far-right fringe group QAnon. In April 2022, he attended the “Patriots Arise for God and County” conference that highlighted conspiracy theories about 9/11, vaccines, 5G, and Democrats trafficking children. And Mastriano didn’t just attend the event—he was a [speaker](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VWMQYT8PqG4fW5D0Dcb99VZrZW8mS6hr4JYMhDN5GS5Sm3q905V1-WJV7Cg-vDW9lg09_2zLxGWW65qvFR1JcL8cW2BwnD95bR_yVW4xS6T71w2VM4W74jFSm1kVTcdW6SHGVN3P8lPdW66vjjX242dDYW7h9lJt3PX31bW3pmJlK5kNWj6W3lhQLM6HljlKN9dt8bkkz5M-W6R_PsJ7gmPxGN567nFSWRXzqW732NG37Xlzn6W5_bc7y6MCM_sW7nS-Tr6-jV90W66p7qR6L8NxzW1RDWRt26DNzMW6895Br15vYQDW7sDTvS8CQrHpW63vX-l9bYHbCW1nCyd21rsrp1W55FZ0n8hq9v1W2m5qBr35P9433jDP1).

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z20956nclgv4kbbvsm7utmmpq4n3vo3o90k1bclo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2utjb7dhicir33dticdrr6cpnmso6aclh6ti76t71eepj5chlmcqb2d3hmiqe6dtnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhm2pm2ptncpj32cljckrr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5c9h61or3cpjm49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmjbnapbtvar0tulkrksv4p0gbqk5eaaiir14i70_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ge6or6cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za53d9l2a5m3do952pc5fbpqvek5ho3psh143im8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ge6or6cth2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3e04dbio4bfa8mviughrph79vo17epu8bg0drr8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ge6or6cth2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: NextGen Pennsylvania
subject: Election Day is closer than you think!
body:
Less than one week left.

Team, In Arizona, we always honor our nation’s veterans who sacrificed so much to keep us safe and secure. **Our courageous veterans risked their lives to defend our country, and they deserve our deepest thanks and appreciation.** I recently had the honor of giving Arizona veterans a Hero’s Welcome as part of the Honor Flight Network’s celebration of Arizona veterans, thanking them for their service. I joined over 100 Arizona veterans from the WWII, Korean, and Vietnam eras on a flight from Phoenix to Washington. This trip marked the Honor Network’s milestone of bringing over 250,000 veterans to our nation’s capital. The veterans received a Hero’s Welcome, a water cannon salute, and visited the memorials in Washington honoring their service. I’m humbled to take part in this celebration and I hope you’ll join us as we continue to salute our veterans for their service to our country. [**Our team works hard every day to ensure Arizona veterans have the care and benefits they’ve earned. Dear Fellow American, Young people today grow up being told that their perception of reality is a matter of perspective. Recently, they are even told that women can choose to be men and men women. This denial of objective reality—including a denial of an objective good—is destructive of proper education, of religious faith, and of free government. Largely as an antidote to this destructive force, Hillsdale College is releasing its latest free online course, “C.S. Lewis on Christianity.” Taught by Michael Ward, a visiting distinguished fellow at Hillsdale and a professor of theology at Oxford University, this seven-lecture course covers Lewis’s philosophical defense of an objective good and his demonstration of its fulfillment in Christianity. **I am writing today to ask if you would consider helping us meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on May 16, so we can promote this new online course effectively, especially to young people.** **** Hillsdale produces its free online courses, as it does all its work, while refusing to accept government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. We are entirely dependent on private donations. With your tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of young people in this new free online course and expand Hillsdale’s other outreach efforts. Please help us reach our $500,000 goal. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cs-lewis-christianity](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zgdmiuu6lv5pg7elhc9jpi0kduirjrv2psj2emd0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ge1ob4cth2bs)** Thank you for your friendship and support. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
For decades, shady dark-money billionaires like George Soros have funneled massive amounts of cash into the pockets of radical left-wing activists to take up government positions in communities all over the country. |
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60364819:JX_lZcogN:m:1:3317145305:91EFDF683BF99EB5D31930074794F29B:r)
Tucker Carlson said it himself: if you're thinking of writing a check...think of writing it to Ryan Girdusky.

I'll tell you why.

I've seen what's happening in our schools -- on our dimes, and I'm sure you have too.

Public schools all over the country are relentlessly pushing Critical Race Theory, and convincing America's children that they need to change their sexual preferences and gender identities.

_**It's state-sanctioned leftist indoctrination, plain and simple.**_

As I discussed on _**Tucker Carlson Tonight**_ , I get rid of the people who are indoctrinating our children by replacing them with SANE conservative Americans.

[**But, I can't do any of this without your help. Would you consider making a generous donation of ANY amount to help me put an end to state sanctioned leftist indoctrination?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60364819:JX_lZcogN:m:1:3317145305:91EFDF683BF99EB5D31930074794F29B:r)

For decades, shady dark-money billionaires like _**George Soros**_ have funneled massive amounts of cash into the pockets of radical left-wing activists to take up government positions in communities all over the country.

_**One of Soros's favorite targets is local school board races.**_

_And I hate to break it to you, but his plan has been wildly successful._

Right now, in EVERY STATE IN AMERICA (including the red states), teachers are indoctrinating our students with CRT.

If you're not familiar with CRT, it's the doctrine that all white people are oppressors, and that your skin color determines everything about you.

Beyond this, _CRT teaches kids that America is evil to its core, and that everything that makes our country great, is secretly racist._

_**Then, what's worse is that these radical school boards allow, hire, and encourage teachers who have been caught ACTIVELY recruiting children to become transgender.**_

And friend, you may not have seen it happening at the time, but for too long Republicans have neglected local races and instead focused on "BIG" races for President, Governor, and Congress.

But in the process, we've left room for people like George Soros to take over local governments all over the country, right under our noses.

Now, with all this doom and gloom, it's easy to feel defeated.

**But I know, and Tucker Carlson knows that this fight is far from over...**

And we CAN take back our schools from the radical left.
[ HELP US TAKE BACK OUR SCHOOLS TODAY! ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60364819:JX_lZcogN:m:1:3317145305:91EFDF683BF99EB5D31930074794F29B:r)
Let me introduce myself.

_**My name is Ryan Girdusky, and I founded the 1776 Project PAC to take back our local school boards from the radical left.**_

_**And I have the 3 R's Battle Plan to do just that!**_

_**Resign**_ : we'll turn up the public pressure with TV, Radio, and Print media campaigns calling for far left school board members to quit.

_**Recall**_ : we'll help collect petitions signatures and aid local parents, grandparents, and concerned taxpayers in efforts to recall radical school board members who must be removed from office.

_**Replace**_ : We'll support the campaigns of pro-America conservatives who run for local school board against liberal pro-CRT school board members.

In the coming year, we are hoping to triple our impact!

[**But, friend, we can't roll out this plan without your support. Will you rush in $17.76 to the 1776 Project PAC as we prepared to target more than 200 races this year?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60364819:JX_lZcogN:m:1:3317145305:91EFDF683BF99EB5D31930074794F29B:r)

Now, I'm guessing you've never heard of me before...

**....But, I'd be willing to bet you've heard Tucker, Laura Ingraham, and Donald Trump Jr.**

I've had the chance to discuss my plan with them, and they all believe that _the 1776 Project PAC's 3 R's Campaign Battle Plan is a game-changer!_

Here's what each of them said:

**> >>> Tucker Carlson:** "Parents have almost no support, but now they do. The _**1776 Project PAC**_ is a political action committee designed to help school boards and communities elect sane people.... If you're thinking of writing a check... Think of writing it to Ryan Girdusky."

**> >>> Laura Ingraham:** "For all the parents out there looking to reclaim your local school boards from radical leftists, help is on the way, a new political action committee called the _**1776 Project**_ is going to support school board candidates who oppose indoctrinating kids with things like Critical Race Theory."

**> >>> Donald Trump Jr.:** "The _**1776 Project**_ is the very first Political Action Committee of it's kind, specifically created to take on this sinister attack on our way of life from within our own communities by working to take local schools boards out of the hands of these America-hating radical liberals..."

Even the failing and biased New York Times admitted that we "lit a fire" that is only growing as more conservative patriots like you join the fight in supporting the 1776 Project PAC.

**But here is the best part. The 1776 Project PAC has only been around for a year, and we already have a track-record of success.**

In November of 2021, we flipped 44 seats. In the coming year, as long as we have your help, we are set to more than TRIPLE our impact.

**After 30 years of left-wing billionaires like George Soros flooding cash into local school board races, we finally have a way to fight back with the 1776 Project PAC.**

[**Please consider helping us fight back against George Soros and the radical socialist left in our school boards with a generous contribution of $17.76, $25, $50, or $100.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60364819:JX_lZcogN:m:1:3317145305:91EFDF683BF99EB5D31930074794F29B:r)

_With your help, we will rid our schools of radical leftists who are hell-bent on turning our kids against conservative, American values..._

**And we'll replace them with sane, America-loving citizens.**

Sincerely,
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60364819:JX_lZcogN:m:1:3317145305:91EFDF683BF99EB5D31930074794F29B:r)
**Ryan Girdusky, President**
_1776 Project PAC_

P.S. I know you may not know anything about me, but I hope that the endorsements from incredible conservative leaders like my friends Tucker, Laura, and Donald Trump Jr. give you confidence in my dedication to the mission of taking school boards back from radical liberals.

[**Will you invest in the future of our country by making a generous contribution to the 1776 Project PAC as we fight to Resign, Recall, or Replace far-left indoctrinators?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60364819:JX_lZcogN:m:1:3317145305:91EFDF683BF99EB5D31930074794F29B:r)
[ HELP US TAKE BACK OUR SCHOOLS TODAY! ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60364819:JX_lZcogN:m:1:3317145305:91EFDF683BF99EB5D31930074794F29B:r)

body:
| The Supreme Court has lost its credibility as a neutral arbiter of the law.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=243%2E5257348%2EZdjIB1)
It’s time to expand the Supreme Court, Derek. And I don’t say this lightly.
It’s the most unrepresentative institution in the United States government. A socially conservative court of partisan justices determined to enact a partisan agenda — as evidenced by the leaked draft opinion to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.
It’s the result of Mitch McConnell withholding a justice when Barack Obama was president, and then forcing through a Trump-nominated justice as voters were electing Joe Biden. This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi4g73dqeljejc8m32l244l2o77copib6u1rhlk0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ie0oj2cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0gq9m4ncl1io4ugn8cmo8u375lm72ugmq48lfao_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ie0oj2cth2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm30sop68t9pi7pusg7bjf8ki312s4u53n9ofjt8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ie0oj2cth2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

I support this decision, and hope that this vote will pass. Unfortunately, Sarah Palin and National Republicans are doing everything they can to block it.

## It’s Now or Never: Let’s Build a Green Economy
---
| | **Our campaign** completely rejects the premise that we cannot afford to stop climate change. We understand that for the last century, our federal government has had no problem spending big when it comes to war, corporate subsidies for the fossil fuel industry, tax cuts for the rich, and Wall Street bailouts. What we cannot afford to do is passively accept the status quo. What we cannot afford to do is continue to believe that people’s lives and the planet we co-inhabit should be subdued to the whims of financial interests as opposed to using finance in the interest of our lives and planet.
* We advocate for policies that **invest** in better infrastructure and logistical systems, more public accountability, tighter regulation on the for profit financial system funding fossil fuels, a wealth tax on billionaires, updated anti monopoly laws, and perhaps most importantly; actively building a **green economy**.
* Our second objective is to secure a**just transition** for workers. This involves ensuring that we stay true to the principles of social and environmental justice, as well as guarantee that every single worker is empowered to have a dignified job in our new economy.
* We will do everything we possibly can to pass and support legislation to rapidly **decarbonize the nation** and beyond with the aim of reaching **net zero emissions**.
* Committing to **democratic accountability** , we can not trust elected officials who take dollars from the same corporations that are willing to let the world burn all in the name of profit. Along with **campaign finance reform** we must join the growing public, postal, and community banking movement to give lending and credit systems more of a “triple bottom line”: **people, planet, and purpose**.
* We support a **federal job guarantee** at a thriving wage with a reduced work week designed around meeting social-environmental needs.

Until Governor Lee can take away our _right_ to safe, legal abortion, he will settle for taking away our access. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45194535/344867133/1451654451?refcode=EM_FR_220511Roe2_MM_BB_30DO_8_G_TESTB_G1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjNmMDI1Ni01NWQxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0R7keauoeJARmwYeDAo0vz-Ga6mYyEVRkmoEWm_PENM=) This bill prohibits any distribution of abortion medication unless prescribed IN PERSON by a physician, including a required follow-up appointment within two weeks. Telehealth appointments and getting prescription medicine by mail is the only way many of us can reasonably receive any health care, let alone reproductive care. | | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zafpppkar2s7qaf1ro83imeq22347qdg0c5cselg_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ieco74chh2bs)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1gmlclp1fcktgpu971su4lpld0ma723nr4aps68_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ieco74chh2bs) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhobpfunjq3ol76bb2mufrio0of8v7jdo4tojs3g_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9ieco74chh2bs) Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

subject: Senate Majority Whip John Gordner endorses Barletta for Governor
body:
| | | |
---
---
**Senate Majority Whip John Gordner endorses Barletta for Governor**
---
Former mayor and congressman Lou Barletta, leading Republican candidate for governor of Pennsylvania, today announced the formal endorsement of Senate Majority Whip John Gordner. Citing Barletta's dedication and record fighting for northeast Pennsylvania, Gordner joins a growing list of northeast Pennsylvania legislators rallying behind Barletta's grassroots campaign including: Senator Lisa Baker, Rep. Aaron Kaufer, Rep. Jonathan Fritz, Rep. Jack Rader, Rep. Karen Boback and Rep. David Millard.
"I am pleased to endorse Lou Barletta for Governor," said **Senate Majority Whip John Gordner**. "I worked closely with Congressman Barletta when he represented our area for almost a decade. He was always available and responsive to our constituent needs. As a former Mayor of Hazleton, he has executive experience as well. With record inflation, employers looking for trained staff, and with the loss of our energy independence reflected in spiraling energy prices, I am confident that Lou Barletta is the candidate with proven leadership abilities who can guide Pennsylvania to a much better tomorrow. As Senate Majority Whip, I look forward to working alongside of Governor Lou Barletta."
"I am grateful to be endorsed by Senate Majority Whip John Gordner," **said Barletta.** "Pennsylvanians are desperate for change in Harrisburg. They want a government that actually stands up and fights for the people - not the special interests or lobbyists. I am proven, road-tested, and ready. As governor, I look forward to working closely with Sen. Gordner and other legislators so we can finally turn the page on the disastrous Wolf/Shapiro regime and unleash the Great Pennsylvania Comeback."

clean_body: | | | | Senate Majority Whip John Gordner endorses Barletta for Governor Former mayor and congressman Lou Barletta, leading Republican candidate for governor of Pennsylvania, today announced the formal endorsement of Senate Majority Whip John Gordner. Citing Barletta's dedication and record fighting for northeast Pennsylvania, Gordner joins a growing list of northeast Pennsylvania legislators rallying behind Barletta's grassroots campaign including: Senator Lisa Baker, Rep. Aaron Kaufer, Rep. Jonathan Fritz, Rep. Jack Rader, Rep. Karen Boback and Rep. David Millard. "I am pleased to endorse Lou Barletta for Governor," said Senate Majority Whip John Gordner. "I worked closely with Congressman Barletta when he represented our area for almost a decade. He was always available and responsive to our constituent needs. As a former Mayor of Hazleton, he has executive experience as well. With record inflation, employers looking for trained staff, and with the loss of our energy independence reflected in spiraling energy prices, I am confident that Lou Barletta is the candidate with proven leadership abilities who can guide Pennsylvania to a much better tomorrow. As Senate Majority Whip, I look forward to working alongside of Governor Lou Barletta." "I am grateful to be endorsed by Senate Majority Whip John Gordner," said Barletta. "Pennsylvanians are desperate for change in Harrisburg. They want a government that actually stands up and fights for the people - not the special interests or lobbyists. I am proven, road-tested, and ready. As governor, I look forward to working closely with Sen. Gordner and other legislators so we can finally turn the page on the disastrous Wolf/Shapiro regime and unleash the Great Pennsylvania Comeback." | | | | =

In March I was officially inducted into the “Young Guns” program, run by the National Republican Congressional Committee. In an email in September, I wrote to you that “ membership is exclusive and serves to recognize candidates who have proven that they can raise enough money online to sustain their campaigns without help from Washington, D.C.” Well, you probably know that once something is given it can just as easily be taken away – and I’m worried that if our fundraising doesn’t pick up soon, I’m going to lose this top tier candidate status. body:
With under a week until the primary, I’m wondering if there’s ANYTHING I can say to convince you to make a donation before it’s too late.
#
Derek,
Look, is there _anything_ I can say to convince you to make your very first donation before our primary election is less than a week?
**_Let me start by saying that..._**
1\. Pennsylvania is the #1 swing state most likely to flip on CNN’s top 10 list.
2\. We’re the only Democratic campaign with a consistent record of beating _every_ Republican opponent in _every_ public poll.
3\. This race has already been named the most expensive Senate race in the country. We need everyone to step up if we’re going to keep up with the millions of dollars our GOP opponents and their super PACs are spending in PA.
**So, Derek...what do you think? I hope you can see why your support in these crucial final days is *so* important.**
[**Can I count on you your very first $5 donation today? Every donation helps, no matter the amount.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220511-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220511-5755&refcode2=5755_434096_P9qjth&akid=5755%2E434096%2EP9qjth)
**_If you’re still reading this...even that didn’t get you to chip in, huh?_**
[**__**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220511-1?refcode=em20220511-5755&refcode2=5755_434096_P9qjth&akid=5755%2E434096%2EP9qjth)
**_Well, what if I told you this..._**
4\. Senate control is in danger in 2022. But if we flip Pennsylvania, our chances of holding a Democratic majority increase dramatically.
5\. And with the leaked decision from SCOTUS regarding _Roe v. Wade_ , we can’t afford a single slip-up in maintaining our Democratic majorities.
6\. We don’t accept any corporate PAC money. We’re funding this campaign with grassroots donations collected over simple emails like this one.
**[Ok, now that I’ve said all that... can I get you to chip in your first ever donation right now? It would make a big difference, because we are in need of a last-minute surge.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220511-1?refcode=em20220511-5755&refcode2=5755_434096_P9qjth&akid=5755%2E434096%2EP9qjth)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220511-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220511-5755&refcode2=5755_434096_P9qjth&akid=5755%2E434096%2EP9qjth)**
If none of that convinced you, or if you can’t give at all, I get it. It’s a tough time and not everyone has extra money to donate to political campaigns. But if you are in a position to give, right now is the best time to do so — _we are *literally* days away from our primary election._
We realllllyyyyy need a surge at the end here, and I know with this team on our side, we’ll get there. 🙏
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

| Peter,

Childhood poverty is a crisis. Here in Upstate New York, the U.S. Census Bureau recently reported that _nearly fifty percent_ of children in Syracuse are living in poverty. Alarming as they are, these reports tell only part of the story. Statistics alone don’t adequately convey the suffering kids experience when they don’t have enough food to eat, warm enough clothes to wear, or access to the support they need.

**It’s unacceptable.**

That is why I have laid out a detailed plan to address child poverty, and I am writing today to share it with you. You can read my op-ed _[here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45196741/344877737/2029705336?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWY4YTFjYi02MGQxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vVqNr7ldFys_baSphtOwOUFgU9wULFN2beMU_jt100c=&emci=78579eec-42d1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=51f8a1cb-60d1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=4588596)_ , and you can see more details on our campaign’s website _[here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45196742/344877738/-1126184350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWY4YTFjYi02MGQxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vVqNr7ldFys_baSphtOwOUFgU9wULFN2beMU_jt100c=&emci=78579eec-42d1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=51f8a1cb-60d1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=4588596#issues)_. I hope you’ll review my plan and send me your ideas to improve it because addressing this crisis will take engagement from all of us.

Childhood poverty is the consequence of decades of policy failures. I’m running for Congress to do things differently, and I appreciate your help getting there.

With gratitude & high hopes,

Hey everyone,

I'm leaving Pittsburgh early tomorrow for our **final** roadtrip of this primary campaign, and it seems like a good time to write you all a note.

When I decided to run for this Senate seat last summer, we decided to run the campaign we knew could beat the GOP in November.

With your help, we built a campaign that doesn't take a dime from corporate PACs.

We've built the campaign supported by workers, bringing together more than 25 Labor Unions from across the state.

I'm a guy from Pittsburgh, but we've won endorsements from organizations like the Black Clergy of Philadelphia and Vicinity, and this weekend, the Philadelphia Inquirer (the largest newspaper in the state).

We're the only campaign with organizers on the ground, working across the state to bring together communities behind our campaign.

That's what it means to put in the work.

Now with less than a week left, we're putting it all to the test.

My team has just set a **$150k grassroots goal** for the primary. That money will be used for two things:

With the support of volunteers from around PA, our organizing operation is reaching more voters than we anticipated. That means we need more pieces of campaign literature than anticipated — several hundred thousand more, actually. This isn’t some made-up fundraising gimmick, and it's great news, but we need help to cover the costs. Our organizing program can win this election, but we need to get them the resources to win.

Secondly, we've seen our name recognition rise throughout PA, especially after the Inquirer endorsement. Now that voters know who we are, we need to let them know what we stand for. That means we need to expand our ad coverage to reach more voters and drive home our message.

I'm in this to win — next week and in November. We've built a campaign that can do it.

subject: State Senator Tommy Tomlinson endorses Barletta for Governor
body:
| | | |
---
---
**State Senator Tommy Tomlinson endorses Barletta for Governor**
---
Former mayor and congressman Lou Barletta, leading Republican candidate for governor of Pennsylvania, today announced the formal endorsement of State Senator Tommy Tomlinson (R-Bucks). Tomlinson's endorsement comes on the heels of Senate Majority Whip John Gordner and Senator Lisa Baker's endorsement of Barletta signaling a coalescing of Republican support behind Barletta's surging grassroots campaign.
“Lou Barletta has the opportunity to be a transformational governor for Pennsylvania and I’m proud to endorse him,” **said Sen. Tommy Tomlinson.** “Lou is a man of impeccable character who has demonstrated that he is not afraid to fight for the people he was elected to represent. I’m proud to join my other Senate colleagues in endorsing Lou Barletta to be Pennsylvania’s next Governor.”
"Senator Tommy Tomlinson is a friend and I'm honored to have his endorsement," **said Barletta.** "Pennsylvania is at a crossroads. We need someone who has the courage to stand up and fight for our values and defeat Josh Shapiro in November. I am proven, road-tested, and ready. Together, with the support of Senator Tomlinson and countless other Pennsylvania conservatives, we will win this primary and defeat Josh Shapiro in November."

clean_body: | | | | State Senator Tommy Tomlinson endorses Barletta for Governor Former mayor and congressman Lou Barletta, leading Republican candidate for governor of Pennsylvania, today announced the formal endorsement of State Senator Tommy Tomlinson (R-Bucks). Tomlinson's endorsement comes on the heels of Senate Majority Whip John Gordner and Senator Lisa Baker's endorsement of Barletta signaling a coalescing of Republican support behind Barletta's surging grassroots campaign. “Lou Barletta has the opportunity to be a transformational governor for Pennsylvania and I’m proud to endorse him,” said Sen. Tommy Tomlinson. “Lou is a man of impeccable character who has demonstrated that he is not afraid to fight for the people he was elected to represent. I’m proud to join my other Senate colleagues in endorsing Lou Barletta to be Pennsylvania’s next Governor.” "Senator Tommy Tomlinson is a friend and I'm honored to have his endorsement," said Barletta. "Pennsylvania is at a crossroads. We need someone who has the courage to stand up and fight for our values and defeat Josh Shapiro in November. I am proven, road-tested, and ready. Together, with the support of Senator Tomlinson and countless other Pennsylvania conservatives, we will win this primary and defeat Josh Shapiro in November." | | | | =

name: Team Padilla
subject: Why the Los Angeles Times endorsed Alex
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
“California and the nation deserve strong leadership in the U.S. Senate, the kind that only Padilla offers in this race.”
#

We've got some BIG news for you today:
**_Our campaign has just been endorsed by the Los Angeles Times!_**
Please, take a minute to read what they had to say below, and then [**make a $5 contribution to help us get out the vote across California before our primary in less than one month.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-may22?refcode=em220511-1-subs&t=1&refcode2=799_159979_SNGFpE&akid=799%2E159979%2ESNGFpE)
\- Team Padilla
* * *
**Endorsement: Alex Padilla for U.S. Senate**
**By: The Times Editorial Board
May 8, 2022**
When Gov. Gavin Newsom named then-California Secretary of State Alex Padilla to fill Kamala Harris’ seat in the U.S. Senate after she was elected vice president, it was the right choice — and not only because it was high time that this state, where 39% of residents are Latino, had a Latino senator.
As the state’s election chief, Padilla had already shown he had the mettle to take on national issues by offering a sober and factual counterpoint to President Trump’s frequent lies about election fraud. And his long political resume as secretary of state, as state senator representing the San Fernando Valley and as Los Angeles City Council president made it clear he was among the few ready to step up to the Senate seat on short notice. He did that with ease, and now, just slightly over a year since he took office, Padilla has proven that he is as capable, as honorable, as skilled a lawmaker as we expected.
California’s junior senator immediately and competently stepped into the debate — pushing to include social safety benefits for immigrants in the “Build Back Better” plan and co-writing bipartisan legislation that, among other things, would reinvest in the nation’s electrical grid and fund electric school buses and were included in last year’s infrastructure package signed by President Biden.
He now faces his first election for the Senate seat. (Or rather, he faces his first elections. Padilla’s name appears on the June 7 ballot twice: first, as a candidate for the remainder of Harris’ term through January 2023 and again for the following full six-year term.) Voters should send him back to Washington without hesitation.
In the Senate, Padilla has established himself as a major advocate for immigrants and the need to create better immigration policy, and has been a staunch advocate for climate change policy and environmental protection. No surprise on either count — Padilla, a Democrat, is the son of immigrants from Mexico and while in the Legislature wrote California’s landmark single-use plastic bag ban. And, importantly in this fraught moment, he is a reliable supporter of reproductive rights and has co-sponsored legislation to enshrine abortion protections in federal law.
Nearly two dozen people are also running for the Senate seat, but none have a fraction of Padilla’s experience. The most prominent is Mark Meuser, a constitutional lawyer who has received the state Republican Party endorsement. Meuser, who unsuccessfully challenged Padilla for California secretary of state in 2018, has positions that are out of line with the values of most Californians. Just one example: Meuser has been a loud critic of mask mandates and other sensible COVID-19 pandemic public health measures and says he has been involved in 22 lawsuits challenging Newsom’s pandemic emergency authority.
California and the nation deserve strong leadership in the U.S. Senate, the kind that only Padilla offers in this race.
* * *
_Alex Padilla is the proud son of immigrants and a proud son of California. He’s fighting in the Senate to defend democracy and the right to vote, protect our environment, increase access to healthcare, and uplift working families._

Please, take a minute to read what they had to say below, and then \- Team Padilla Endorsement: Alex Padilla for U.S. Senate By: The Times Editorial Board May 8, 2022 When Gov. Gavin Newsom named then-California Secretary of State Alex Padilla to fill Kamala Harris’ seat in the U.S. Senate after she was elected vice president, it was the right choice — and not only because it was high time that this state, where 39% of residents are Latino, had a Latino senator. As the state’s election chief, Padilla had already shown he had the mettle to take on national issues by offering a sober and factual counterpoint to President Trump’s frequent lies about election fraud. And his long political resume as secretary of state, as state senator representing the San Fernando Valley and as Los Angeles City Council president made it clear he was among the few ready to step up to the Senate seat on short notice. He did that with ease, and now, just slightly over a year since he took office, Padilla has proven that he is as capable, as honorable, as skilled a lawmaker as we expected. California’s junior senator immediately and competently stepped into the debate — pushing to include social safety benefits for immigrants in the “Build Back Better” plan and co-writing bipartisan legislation that, among other things, would reinvest in the nation’s electrical grid and fund electric school buses and were included in last year’s infrastructure package signed by President Biden. He now faces his first election for the Senate seat. (Or rather, he faces his first elections. Padilla’s name appears on the June 7 ballot twice: first, as a candidate for the remainder of Harris’ term through January 2023 and again for the following full six-year term.) Voters should send him back to Washington without hesitation. In the Senate, Padilla has established himself as a major advocate for immigrants and the need to create better immigration policy, and has been a staunch advocate for climate change policy and environmental protection. No surprise on either count — Padilla, a Democrat, is the son of immigrants from Mexico and while in the Legislature wrote California’s landmark single-use plastic bag ban. And, importantly in this fraught moment, he is a reliable supporter of reproductive rights and has co-sponsored legislation to enshrine abortion protections in federal law. Nearly two dozen people are also running for the Senate seat, but none have a fraction of Padilla’s experience. The most prominent is Mark Meuser, a constitutional lawyer who has received the state Republican Party endorsement. Meuser, who unsuccessfully challenged Padilla for California secretary of state in 2018, has positions that are out of line with the values of most Californians. Just one example: Meuser has been a loud critic of mask mandates and other sensible COVID-19 pandemic public health measures and says he has been involved in 22 lawsuits challenging Newsom’s pandemic emergency authority. California and the nation deserve strong leadership in the U.S. Senate, the kind that only Padilla offers in this race. Alex Padilla is the proud son of immigrants and a proud son of California. He’s fighting in the Senate to defend democracy and the right to vote, protect our environment, increase access to healthcare, and uplift working families. Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate

name: Great America Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6997%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=7IAsBF9t0YxOE3G49eWlrg&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61961%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wYqG%2fHr1BGMRG49roTDPyQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61962%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NpsUrGlTxzoysnS8Et3i%2fw&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61962%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NpsUrGlTxzoysnS8Et3i%2fw&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
Our team was busy last week as we continued preparing for the June 7th Primary, which is now just 27 days away. | |

| Last week our team continued preparing for the June 7th Primary, which is now just 27 days away. We attended a Candidate Forum, the Morris County Republican Alliance Beefsteak Dinner, local sporting events, a mother’s day brunch hosted by the Stay Safe Foundation, and much more.
**With the primary just weeks away, we need your help now more than ever.**

Volunteer with us, donate and get your friends and family prepared to vote for John on June 7th. Whether it’s 5 dollars, 5 hours of volunteering, or getting us 5 votes, it all brings us one step closer to winning.

| Peter-
I recently gave a speech to a group of Texans about wokeism. This isn't your typical speech. We all have a general understanding of what "woke" means. We see it every day in America's schools, in the mainstream media, in Congress, and in the White House.
But few understand the *why* behind the woke. Why does the left pursue these radical cultural fights? Why is nothing - not even our children - off-limits? Why is it so important that we win this fight?
I explore all of these questions in the speech below. It's long, but I hope you'll read it. And if you agree with me, [I hope you'll consider donating to my campaign here.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xrdLrs4l6JK7v2PRN332TWiqcD3JitKT7qfO0BicQKD3qhLqHq0lEfuClALFZniXPMDo2rXmpFe-jb5xe0g3BS_vOQk-o3Xn2cMcrFxqP2gDDTITjoy0xOx70bMrakc_k_cpJkAB8qCTtNr2vk4APK0nOzuw4h8sOxet67teFYK2BdIghkc4wZi1qeXmC8xXgSNKy_O4vg_1tO_S5OiIB8vjy6hU2Ycc2yZ2q9guFqpy7rO1S8rLQWzlV1Eilpya8gMKY6lNEf0UrRbCezIot2jEOimIK_9Q3froLF_jyrd6DuFcIPveQrHKd2Tdev29VerHc8yYpYS1m3NZ1f0s2obYeIm2_lO1b4x_NUQJDGY=&c=QI2MdzW--93d2GduajKuoTGVLov-mTYCDUVNuL_KM4dweZQ2EcPaww==&ch=3UB0oalMm2FA7UlBHY20GvFmlGvEwSzQUZA21r0rUFHENOTGkOcm6A==)
This is a fight we cannot lose. And we can't win this fight without patriots like you.
Thank you for reading and for your support.
