The Why Behind the Woke By Dan Crenshaw Delivered Friday, May 6 in Texas
We know wokeism is a problem. I think we all know what it refers to; we all have a basic understanding of the trend the word "woke" describes. But let's not confuse that knowledge with an actual understanding of the problem. Many know what woke is, and they know they don't like it, but few understand the why behind the woke.
So I want to focus today on understanding the problem, because there can be no call to action without first examining the battlefield.
Let me tell you a story about a fascinating woman, Nancy Green.
She was born a slave in 1834 Montgomery County, KY. and became a wealthy superstar in the advertising world, as its first living trademark. Green was 56 years old when she was selected as spokesperson for a new ready-mixed, self-rising pancake flour and made her debut in 1893 at a fair and exposition in Chicago. She demonstrated the pancake mix and served thousands of pancakes, and became an immediate star. She was a good storyteller, her personality was warm and appealing, and her showmanship was exceptional. Her newfound financial freedom and stature as a national spokesperson enabled her to become a leading advocate on issues like poverty and equal rights for all Americans. This was a remarkable woman, and sadly she has been ERASED by woke politics.
Now of course I am talking about Aunt Jemimah.
This plays out time and time again. Sometimes it's Columbus, sometimes it's a Founding Father, sometimes it's a kids show, sometimes it's a marketing icon. Cancel culture seems to know no bounds, but what exactly are the woke trying to erase? What is the common thread of cancellations?
The common thread I see is the desire to erase our collection of heroes and happy myths. For any nation to survive, there has to be a set of collective values we share, a set of shared stories that we tell. America is not a tribe, and we are not ethnically connected to each other in any real way, we have a seemingly infinite number of micro-cultures around the country from surf bums to rednecks - and so with all this diversity, sharing the same stories is incredibly important for a nation like ours.
We share the same stories of our founding, and of our struggle through history. We celebrate together on the 4th of July, we take time off for Christmas, as we are a nation founded under a Judeo-Christian moral framework. We share American past times like baseball and football and March Madness. We tell stories of our proud achievements, like defeating the Soviet Union, defeating the Nazis, or landing on the moon. And we perpetuate our shared values - hard work, kindness, the use of reason, charity.
The list goes on and pretty soon you have a picture of what it is to be an American.
The woke want to rip up that picture, and they do so by attacking and discrediting every element of that shared story, little by little.
To be woke is to be resentful for resentment's sake. It is to hold a belief that our foundations are corrupt to the core, and must be destroyed. It is revolution for revolution's sake, with nothing on the other side except chaos.
So why on earth would anyone want this? Let's examine some defining features of wokeism and perhaps come up with an answer to that question.
The first feature is that wokeism is a religion. It bears all the hallmarks of a religion. It must mimic religion because religion gives people purpose and meaning, and that's what the wokes are after.
Wokeism has gods: the god of climate change, the god of anti-racism, the god of diversity.
Wokeism promises redemption. It promises to cleanse its followers of their participation in the sins of systemic racism, whiteness, toxic masculinity, or transphobia.
Wokeism has religious texts, written by Ibram X. Kendi and Nicole Hannah Jones and Ta-Nehisi Coates, and a whole slew of radical academics that have successfully manufactured a new doublespeak language that simultaneously indicates membership in the cult, while also obfuscating their meaning or intent. A key element of woke literature is that it can never be pinned down, never falsified, and ultimately you can never understand what the hell they are talking about.
Wokeism has religious symbols to indicate membership; they come in the form of preferred pronouns on a Twitter bio, or lawn signs that explain your household believes "science is real," "black lives matter," and "no human being is illegal."
And of course Wokeism has sacred rituals and sacrifices, like repenting of one's white privilege, self-flagellation, or canceling the heretics that do not adhere to the woke religion.
The second feature of wokeism worth noting is its obsession with identity - mostly race, but others as well. Gender, sexual orientation, socio-economic. It is a doctrine of anti-individualism and completely opposite to western values that place the uniqueness and divine nature of the individual front and center. I suppose they do this for a variety of reasons. For one thing, playing off group resentment is a more efficient means of manipulation. It's harder for me to gin up outrage and gather followers by speaking to each person's individual concerns. Far easier to label whole groups as good or evil and establish the requisite hierarchies.
Third - It is about victimhood. This is closely related to their obsession with group politics. Again, instead of attempting to identify victimhood individually and within the scope of commonly held standards of justice, they simply label entire groups as victims, oppressors, or champions of the oppressed. The woke are of course the self-described champions, the good guys.
This is yet another effective strategy for manipulation because it plays to a very human desire - which is to feel as though others are more responsible for your lot in life than you are. This sentiment is in direct contradiction to the traditional American value of self-reliance, and that is exactly the point. Deconstruct the foundations.
The fourth element is revolution. And let's be honest there's a very natural human draw to the romanticism of revolution. You rebel against authority and against your parents because it just feels kind of good. You combine that natural tendency with an unnatural lack of purpose felt by many young students, and you get a dangerous combination in which they seek to fill their purpose through the destruction of the foundations they stand upon.
Revolution is a necessary step for the woke activist because they must deconstruct foundations and destroy norms in order to usher in their version of utopia. Nevermind that their utopia looks like Portland or the autonomous zone in Seattle from 2020.
Key to this feature is the necessary creation of crisis. Crises all around you, in the form of systemic racism, widespread police brutality, climate related natural disasters. It is no wonder that young people have abnormally high levels of anxiety. They are being told the world is ending, or it's inherently evil and SHOULD end. You need to persuade people the system is broken for anyone to want radical change, and the woke revolutionaries attempt to do exactly that.
But in the end, it is ultimately about power. This is the last feature of wokeism. When I say power I mean it in two senses. First, wokeism asserts that all social dynamics are predicated upon power dynamics. Life is a zero sum game to the woke, in that any success must have been achieved by way of oppression. If you're doing better than I am, it is because your group asserts power over my group.....and it is unjust power, at that.
And so if this is true, then it's no wonder that the woke's strategy is to shift around those power dynamics, which gets to the second part. Ultimately their goal is to gain power for themselves and their movement.
They do this by preying on our better nature, our sense of empathy and compassion, to induce submission. They do it subtly at first, then with more aggressive tactics.
It reminds me of my training in the intelligence community. When you're training to be a case officer - meaning your job is to recruit and handle assets, or spies - you are taught to establish a subtle dominance over the person you are recruiting. The common example, the subtle but meaningful step, is practically undetectable. Ask them to pass you a glass of water from across the table, even though it's clearly within your reach. Politely direct them to sit in the seat you want them to sit in. Show them through the door. Subconsciously they start to understand who is boss.
The woke strategy is hardly different, but focuses more on language and rituals.
To give but one quick example : the American Medical Association recently published its "Guide to Language, Narrative and Concepts," which includes such recommendations as replacing the term "disadvantaged" with "historically and intentionally excluded," replacing "vulnerable" with "oppressed," and "blacklist" and "blackmail" with words that don't use the word "black."
These are all different words with different meanings but the wokes want you to say things you know are not true, as a test of your loyalty to the doctrine. You will eventually believe the sky is green and the grass is blue, if you repeat it enough times.
So that's a brief description of the battlefield, now how do we fight it?
I can tell you one thing. You don't fight woke with woke.
If wokeism is the tearing up of foundations, the mindless pursuit of heretics in our midst, and an obsession with victimhood, then I can certainly think of some examples on the right as well, especially amongst the self-labeled populist camp of the right.
Let me lay out some political tactics for you and you tell me who you think it applies to:
Step 1 - Provoke the opposition with some stupid or insidious comment or action
Step 2 - Feign disbelief that anyone would react at all to your behavior. "Why are you guys so obsessed with me? Are you trying to date me or something?"
Step 3 - Claim victimhood. It's them who are being unreasonable, not you. The establishment is trying to keep you down!
Step 4 - Use your newfound victimhood as a self-righteous club to wield back against your enemies. Maybe do it with a fundraising email too.
Sound familiar? The left may have dreamed up this nonsense but there's plenty on the right who - lacking in the sophistication to do otherwise - have sought to fight "fire with fire!"
But here's the thing. You don't actually fight fire with fire. That is a stupid thing to do. You fight fire with water.
You fight wokeism not with more angry wokeism but with conservatism.
So if I have a call to action for you, it's this: we need to re-establish what it means to be a conservative.
For civilization to prosper, for it to advance, we must simultaneously allow creative destruction while also preserving the foundations that got us here in the first place. Fundamentally this is what conservatism offers - a protection of those foundations, and a responsible path for creative progress and innovation.
On the right, we get so wrapped up in the latest controversy about some woke corporation that we forget to talk about the very foundations we fight for and why they matter.
We can't just repeat a familiar phrase like "Faith, Family, and Freedom" or broadly The Constitution, and think people will understand us.
We need to search a little deeper.
Our foundations are political, economic, and cultural. The woke movement targets each one of these. Let me briefly describe all three:
Our political foundations are republican, small "r." We have a republic, not a majoritarian democracy. Look, 51% of you in this room could vote to confiscate the wealth of the other 49% and call it democracy. See how that turns out. There's a reason our Founders designed a system of checks and balances that protects the rights of minorities, and the inalienable rights of the individual. When the left says they want to democratize everything from your business to your wealth, they mean it quite literally.
Our economic foundations are of the Adam Smith tradition. Wealth creation is not a zero sum game. Free exchange, property rights, freedom of association - these things are ingredients for prosperity. If there is a more perfect economic system that creates more wealth for more people, no one has discovered it yet.
Our cultural foundations began in Jerusalem. The Judeo-Christian moral framework underwrites our political and economic foundations and ultimately our prosperity. Because it was this tradition that gave birth to the concept of the divine individual. Created in God's image, any man or woman of any class or creed can be one with God. That was mankind's first introduction to true equality and America was born because of it.
Our culture is also deeply Western. We value a strong work ethic, a meritocracy, politeness, humor, charity, and rules based notion of liberty. We believe that self-reliance and personal responsibility are a keystone of a free society, because you cannot possibly be free if you are afraid to fail. If you believe others should be responsible for you, then you must, necessarily, take their freedoms from them. Or ask some politician to do it for you.
The next step is delivering this philosophy in a way people can understand.
The key to persuading the public is to apply these foundations to the average American's daily life.
Here's a quick example:
A new biomedical device doesn't become widely available and save lives because a bunch of well-intentioned politicians created a new government program. It happened because our culture believes in hard work and competition and isn't afraid of failure. It happened because our economy is free to allow investments and profits and therefore incentivizes constant improvement. And it happened because 51% of the population couldn't just vote to confiscate the technology for themselves once it was created.
It is the conservative philosophy that protects the things we care about, the things that work. So your call to action is to go out and tell that story, without reservation, and without fear of reprisal.
No one should be timid in the fight for what is right, for what works, or for the country that has delivered more prosperity for more people than any other nation in history.
All the hard work has been done for us already, the blood has already been shed. All we have to do is protect it.

So why on earth would anyone want this? Let's examine some defining features of wokeism and perhaps come up with an answer to that question. The first feature is that wokeism is a religion. It bears all the hallmarks of a religion. It must mimic religion because religion gives people purpose and meaning, and that's what the wokes are after. Wokeism has gods: the god of climate change, the god of anti-racism, the god of diversity. Wokeism promises redemption. It promises to cleanse its followers of their participation in the sins of systemic racism, whiteness, toxic masculinity, or transphobia. Wokeism has religious texts, written by Ibram X. Kendi and Nicole Hannah Jones and Ta-Nehisi Coates, and a whole slew of radical academics that have successfully manufactured a new doublespeak language that simultaneously indicates membership in the cult, while also obfuscating their meaning or intent. A key element of woke literature is that it can never be pinned down, never falsified, and ultimately you can never understand what the hell they are talking about. Wokeism has religious symbols to indicate membership; they come in the form of preferred pronouns on a Twitter bio, or lawn signs that explain your household believes "science is real," "black lives matter," and "no human being is illegal." And of course Wokeism has sacred rituals and sacrifices, like repenting of one's white privilege, self-flagellation, or canceling the heretics that do not adhere to the woke religion. The second feature of wokeism worth noting is its obsession with identity - mostly race, but others as well. Gender, sexual orientation, socio-economic. It is a doctrine of anti-individualism and completely opposite to western values that place the uniqueness and divine nature of the individual front and center. I suppose they do this for a variety of reasons. For one thing, playing off group resentment is a more efficient means of manipulation. It's harder for me to gin up outrage and gather followers by speaking to each person's individual concerns. Far easier to label whole groups as good or evil and establish the requisite hierarchies. Third - It is about victimhood. This is closely related to their obsession with group politics. Again, instead of attempting to identify victimhood individually and within the scope of commonly held standards of justice, they simply label entire groups as victims, oppressors, or champions of the oppressed. The woke are of course the self-described champions, the good guys. This is yet another effective strategy for manipulation because it plays to a very human desire - which is to feel as though others are more responsible for your lot in life than you are. This sentiment is in direct contradiction to the traditional American value of self-reliance, and that is exactly the point. Deconstruct the foundations. The fourth element is revolution. And let's be honest there's a very natural human draw to the romanticism of revolution. You rebel against authority and against your parents because it just feels kind of good. You combine that natural tendency with an unnatural lack of purpose felt by many young students, and you get a dangerous combination in which they seek to fill their purpose through the destruction of the foundations they stand upon. Revolution is a necessary step for the woke activist because they must deconstruct foundations and destroy norms in order to usher in their version of utopia. Nevermind that their utopia looks like Portland or the autonomous zone in Seattle from 2020. Key to this feature is the necessary creation of crisis. Crises all around you, in the form of systemic racism, widespread police brutality, climate related natural disasters. It is no wonder that young people have abnormally high levels of anxiety. They are being told the world is ending, or it's inherently evil and SHOULD end. You need to persuade people the system is broken for anyone to want radical change, and the woke revolutionaries attempt to do exactly that. But in the end, it is ultimately about power. This is the last feature of wokeism. When I say power I mean it in two senses. First, wokeism asserts that all social dynamics are predicated upon power dynamics. Life is a zero sum game to the woke, in that any success must have been achieved by way of oppression. If you're doing better than I am, it is because your group asserts power over my group.....and it is unjust power, at that. And so if this is true, then it's no wonder that the woke's strategy is to shift around those power dynamics, which gets to the second part. Ultimately their goal is to gain power for themselves and their movement. They do this by preying on our better nature, our sense of empathy and compassion, to induce submission. They do it subtly at first, then with more aggressive tactics. It reminds me of my training in the intelligence community. When you're training to be a case officer - meaning your job is to recruit and handle assets, or spies - you are taught to establish a subtle dominance over the person you are recruiting. The common example, the subtle but meaningful step, is practically undetectable. Ask them to pass you a glass of water from across the table, even though it's clearly within your reach. Politely direct them to sit in the seat you want them to sit in. Show them through the door. Subconsciously they start to understand who is boss. The woke strategy is hardly different, but focuses more on language and rituals. To give but one quick example : the American Medical Association recently published its "Guide to Language, Narrative and Concepts," which includes such recommendations as replacing the term "disadvantaged" with "historically and intentionally excluded," replacing "vulnerable" with "oppressed," and "blacklist" and "blackmail" with words that don't use the word "black." These are all different words with different meanings but the wokes want you to say things you know are not true, as a test of your loyalty to the doctrine. You will eventually believe the sky is green and the grass is blue, if you repeat it enough times. So that's a brief description of the battlefield, now how do we fight it? I can tell you one thing. You don't fight woke with woke. If wokeism is the tearing up of foundations, the mindless pursuit of heretics in our midst, and an obsession with victimhood, then I can certainly think of some examples on the right as well, especially amongst the self-labeled populist camp of the right. Let me lay out some political tactics for you and you tell me who you think it applies to: Step 1 - Provoke the opposition with some stupid or insidious comment or action Step 2 - Feign disbelief that anyone would react at all to your behavior. "Why are you guys so obsessed with me? Are you trying to date me or something?" Step 3 - Claim victimhood. It's them who are being unreasonable, not you. The establishment is trying to keep you down! Step 4 - Use your newfound victimhood as a self-righteous club to wield back against your enemies. Maybe do it with a fundraising email too. Sound familiar? The left may have dreamed up this nonsense but there's plenty on the right who - lacking in the sophistication to do otherwise - have sought to fight "fire with fire!" But here's the thing. You don't actually fight fire with fire. That is a stupid thing to do. You fight fire with water. You fight wokeism not with more angry wokeism but with conservatism. So if I have a call to action for you, it's this: we need to re-establish what it means to be a conservative. For civilization to prosper, for it to advance, we must simultaneously allow creative destruction while also preserving the foundations that got us here in the first place. Fundamentally this is what conservatism offers - a protection of those foundations, and a responsible path for creative progress and innovation. On the right, we get so wrapped up in the latest controversy about some woke corporation that we forget to talk about the very foundations we fight for and why they matter. We can't just repeat a familiar phrase like "Faith, Family, and Freedom" or broadly The Constitution, and think people will understand us. We need to search a little deeper. Our foundations are political, economic, and cultural. The woke movement targets each one of these. Let me briefly describe all three: Our political foundations are republican, small "r." We have a republic, not a majoritarian democracy. Look, 51% of you in this room could vote to confiscate the wealth of the other 49% and call it democracy. See how that turns out. There's a reason our Founders designed a system of checks and balances that protects the rights of minorities, and the inalienable rights of the individual. When the left says they want to democratize everything from your business to your wealth, they mean it quite literally. Our economic foundations are of the Adam Smith tradition. Wealth creation is not a zero sum game. Free exchange, property rights, freedom of association - these things are ingredients for prosperity. If there is a more perfect economic system that creates more wealth for more people, no one has discovered it yet. Our cultural foundations began in Jerusalem. The Judeo-Christian moral framework underwrites our political and economic foundations and ultimately our prosperity. Because it was this tradition that gave birth to the concept of the divine individual. Created in God's image, any man or woman of any class or creed can be one with God. That was mankind's first introduction to true equality and America was born because of it. Our culture is also deeply Western. We value a strong work ethic, a meritocracy, politeness, humor, charity, and rules based notion of liberty. We believe that self-reliance and personal responsibility are a keystone of a free society, because you cannot possibly be free if you are afraid to fail. If you believe others should be responsible for you, then you must, necessarily, take their freedoms from them. Or ask some politician to do it for you. The next step is delivering this philosophy in a way people can understand. The key to persuading the public is to apply these foundations to the average American's daily life. Here's a quick example: A new biomedical device doesn't become widely available and save lives because a bunch of well-intentioned politicians created a new government program. It happened because our culture believes in hard work and competition and isn't afraid of failure. It happened because our economy is free to allow investments and profits and therefore incentivizes constant improvement. And it happened because 51% of the population couldn't just vote to confiscate the technology for themselves once it was created. It is the conservative philosophy that protects the things we care about, the things that work. So your call to action is to go out and tell that story, without reservation, and without fear of reprisal. No one should be timid in the fight for what is right, for what works, or for the country that has delivered more prosperity for more people than any other nation in history. All the hard work has been done for us already, the blood has already been shed. All we have to do is protect it. | | | | | == | | | Whether you ==, your gift won't just sit in a "war chest". It will be put to immediate use to unseat Democrats in swing districts across the country, exposing the truth about the Biden-Pelosi radical agenda to millions of voters, and building the next generation of the conservative movement with events like Dan Crenshaw's annual youth summit. | | | | | | | Paid for by Dan Crenshaw for Congress | | Crenshaw for Congress | 5900 Memorial Drive, Suite 215, Houston, TX 77007 | | Sent by mailto:dan.crenshaw@crenshawforcongress.com

subject: Read before the vote
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
Despite the fact that over 70% of Americans support protecting Roe v. Wade, this vote is most likely to fail. All because of the filibuster.
#
Peter,
Later today, the Senate will hold a vote for the Women’s Health Protection Act — which would codify abortion rights in response to news that the Supreme Court plans on overturning _Roe v. Wade_ in the coming weeks.
Despite the fact that over 70% of Americans support protecting _Roe v. Wade_ , **this vote is most likely to fail. All because of the filibuster.**
Politicians like Mitch McConnell and Rand Paul have made it clear that they couldn't care less about our needs: they will continue using the filibuster to block the Women’s Health Protection Act, voting protections, climate action, and so much more.**If we want to save abortion access in our country, we must abolish the filibuster.**
[**Before the vote starts today, will you please sign our petition demanding the Senate to abolish the filibuster so we can finally pass the Women’s Health Protection Act?**](https://act.charlesbooker.org/signup/filibuster-petition-0511/?source=em20220511&t=1&akid=1905%2E346206%2ERmrJoP)
**[ABOLISH THE FILIBUSTER →](https://act.charlesbooker.org/signup/filibuster-petition-0511/?source=em20220511&t=2&akid=1905%2E346206%2ERmrJoP)**
We can’t underestimate the urgency of this moment, Peter.
**If action isn’t taken soon, abortion access will disappear all across the country** — including in Kentucky, where we are already fighting a law that would effectively ban abortions in our State.
_This is why_ we’re running against Rand Paul, who has consistently upheld an anti-woman, anti-family agenda and voted against the protections we need to defend reproductive rights.
_This is why_ it’s so critical we expand our Senate majority and end the destructive filibuster that has blocked so many opportunities to protect abortion access in our country.
_And this is why_ we’re reaching out to you, to ask for your support, Peter.
**It’s going to take a loud, widespread call to action if we want to abolish the filibuster.**[**Please add your name right now before the Senate votes today demanding that they abolish the filibuster so we can pass the Women’s Health Protection Act and everything in our progressive agenda.**](https://act.charlesbooker.org/signup/filibuster-petition-0511/?source=em20220511&t=3&akid=1905%2E346206%2ERmrJoP)
**[ABOLISH THE FILIBUSTER →](https://act.charlesbooker.org/signup/filibuster-petition-0511/?source=em20220511&t=4&akid=1905%2E346206%2ERmrJoP)**
Together,
Team Booker

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zuqr9f3j3d8giq2s6nal3vv2t8p0fr8bo673arjo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbr7aor76dh65d3jeiqb4srm6eqb6dtnciq6apj0saq70p5nchhn9d3h6li39o70sv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i69j30tpjc3jrcoj661ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clh6co34c1h6coh5u)
This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zufsdrr3ablcfojsrit469tfhkmucoac2se2tk6o_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpg68o32cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6f39r8h3d64jk8ccgv6thur99vdptohfap5352o_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpg68o32cph2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcqepjnrh5vkga3ate9gb2qgbaib76a0e4he0rcg_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpg68o32cph2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

body:
Several years ago, then Vice President Biden helped champion an agreement with Iran that put verifiable constraints on their nuclear ambitions.
#
Derek —
Several years ago, then Vice President Biden helped champion an agreement with Iran that put verifiable constraints on their nuclear ambitions.
The agreement made us, our allies, and the entire world safer... until Trump took over and tore up the agreement.
Since then, and thanks to Trump, Iran has taken steps beyond the original agreement that has reduced their “breakout time” — the time needed to produce the material to make a nuclear weapon — to just a few weeks.
Now that President Biden is back in office, we have a chance to restore the nuclear deal — and make us safe once again.
The vast majority of Republicans oppose a deal (of course) and even some Democrats do as well.
That is why we are creating a petition we want to release with as many signatures of veterans, military family members, Gold Star families, and civilian supporters as we can find. So please:
[**Sign VoteVets' petition: tell Congress you want their support on any deal negotiated by President Biden to prevent Iran from ever obtaining a nuclear weapon.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/vv_iran_deal?source=em220511-1-15&t=1&akid=5832%2E3013755%2EPzH6nB)

subject: Your 2022 Second Amendment Survey
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWMVo3jhNH

The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation's
history and undermine our Constitution-with a special emphasis on
eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you're receiving
Hillsdale College's Second Amendment Survey because you're
someone who understands that education is essential to the
defense of liberty.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWMVo3jhNH

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous
tax-deductible gift today.

And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll
send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our
thank you.

This hat commemorates our partnership with
USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best
American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and
Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited!

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second
Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take
our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will
only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve
liberty for future generations. Thank you!

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: We must protect control of the Senate to prevent a federal abortion ban.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=zEZvydXEhBOXAk92pHk9WlwMk7ReiVNk&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
Senate Republicans just failed the American people, again.
They just blocked passage of the Women's Health Protection Act - legislation I co-authored and am lead sponsor to, designed to enshrine the fundamental human right of healthcare into federal law for all American women.
Right-wing extremists - after a half-century long war on women's fundamental healthcare rights - are seeing their work come to fruition: Their conservative justices on the U.S. Supreme Court are signaling boldly their intent to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , triggering existing and future abortion bans that will impact more than 36 million women. Meanwhile, not only have two GOP senators aleady proposed a national abortion ban, there have been suggestions of broader discussion if they retake control of the Senate.
**I know you 're feeling angry, perhaps fearful. But we must harness all our emotions into protecting every pro-choice Democratic seat - so that supporters of reproductive freedom retain control of Congress and a nationwide abortion ban can never see the light of day. [Please, if you're with me, will you pitch in a donation of $5 to defend my must-win Senate seat and ensure Mitch McConnell can't take back Senate control?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1178-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
A GOP-instituted national abortion ban would unleash an unprecedented violation of human and civil rights unlike anything seen in developed democracies. While abortion access across the world is _increasing_ , this egregious ruling from the Supreme Court and proposed legislation from Republicans will pave the way for women's healthcare freedoms to disappear, putting countless lives a risk. Abortions will still happen, but women - particularly poor women - will be driven to get them in dangerous and perilous conditions.
This attack on human rights, privacy, and individual liberty is the direct consequence of anti-democratic actions by the Republican Party: Despite representing a minority of Americans in the Senate, they conspired and obstructed their way to confirming three ultraconservative Supreme Court justices - justices appointed by Donald Trump, a morally bankrupt president who lost the popular vote in both of his campaigns.
This attack is the antithesis to any sort of functioning democracy. The soul of the Republican Party has been lost to extremism. **For the sake of our civil and human rights, we must fight back and protect Democratic control of Congress.**
**Remember, Mitch McConnell only needs to flip a single seat to steal back control and pass the dangerous legislation Republican senators are plotting.[Protecting our control of the Senate hinges on winning here in Connecticut against my Trump-aligned opponent. Please, will you make a donation of $5 or more right now to help me keep this seat blue and stop a nationwide abortion ban?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1178-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thanks for stepping up,
Dick

| | | Friend, **__**For Granite State families and families across the country,_THIS_ has become the biggest concern... I’m talking about the devastating consequences of the **_failed economic policies_** that have come out of Washington! Inflation is at a 40-year high with no end in sight. Our national GDP actually had _negative_ growth in the first quarter of 2022. **And grocery prices rose 8.6% in March alone!** All the while, Joe Biden and Hollywood Hassan have only made excuses. They’ve tried to blame everything from COVID-19 to Ukraine, but the truth is that this broken economy is the direct result of unchecked government spending and complete lack of fiscal discipline at the federal level. We need real solutions like the kind I put forward as State Senate President here in New Hampshire. That’s why, as a candidate for the U.S. Senate running to replace Hassan and her excuses, **I’m excited to put forward the following plan to**** _FIX_****Washington’s mistakes and****MAKE OUR ECONOMY GREAT AGAIN!**

---
---
| |
---
| | [JOIN ME: MAKE OUR ECONOMY GREAT AGAIN!](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0xOTQ3OTI5NDIwNzM1OTc3ODI2JmM9YjFnMiZlPTAmYj05NjgxMTIyMjcmZD16N2s0aDhm.BLq5o-H6xjJnN_fE8YDU_FtUNvl-BfmMZVQG52PRciQ)
---
---
| | | Take a look at some of the provisions below: **#1: Return Fiscal Responsibility to Washington** \- At its most basic, inflation is the result of government debt increasing beyond the ability to repay. With Biden and Hassan spending a fortune on far-left priorities, it’s only adding fuel to the inflation fire. And worse yet - much of the debt becomes held by foreign countries like China. We need fiscal discipline, balanced budgets, and sustainable economic growth: just like we have here in New Hampshire. **#2: Restore Energy Independence** \- When President Trump was in charge, the U.S. was on the path back to energy independence. But the Biden Administration, with the help of Maggie Hassan, has returned us to the days of relying on foreign governments like Russia and Middle East nations. Now, gas prices are $2 more than they were in September 2021 - we need to supercharge our energy production and cut the bureaucratic red tape to end this crisis. **#3: Cut Regulations** \- Unnecessary federal regulations are far too often the cause of artificially high prices for everyday commodities. We should undertake a thorough review of federal regulations to cut the unnecessary waste. **#4: Resolve Supply Chain Issues** \- We’ve all seen videos of cargo ships lined up at sea and barren shelves in grocery stores... It’s time for major reform on the way our supply chain is regulated, including stopping unions and environmentalists from holding back our progress. **#5: Reverse Policies that Make America Less Competitive** \- Greater capacity for domestic manufacturing, in addition to lowering our combined corporate tax rate which is _HIGHER_ than the international standard, will help prevent our country from being at a disadvantage. **There is no quick fix to all of the damage that Hassan and Biden have done to our economy. But it’s crucial that we stop their disastrous policies before it’s too late...** We need balanced spending, not overregulation. We need to do things the 603 Way - not the D.C. Way. **We need to Make Our Economy**** __Great__****Again!**

# Campaign Update
---
| |
---
| Erik went up against the other Congressional District 7 (CD7) Candidates in two separate debates this last week.
Last Thursday, around eighty constituents in Park County joined the candidates at the American Legion in Fairplay to hear point and counterpoint. Questions covered current issues and concerns including Border Security, Ukraine, Term Limits and much more. The assemblage expressed overwhelming support for Erik by giving him over 65% of the vote in a landslide win.
In Bailey on Monday, Platte Canyon High School hosted all three candidates for CD7 in an open forum attended by over 100 constituents from the surrounding area, and online in a live-stream. After more than an hour of spirited debate, Erik once again drew in the gallery for another landslide, receiving the nod from over 59% of the community's voters. His next closest challenger was thirty-eight points behind, securing Erik as the clear frontrunner once again.
---
| |
---|---
|
In between debates, Erik and family joined Aadland for Congress volunteers to walk neighborhoods in Broomfield on Saturday.

It was fun to see the surprise on faces when neighbors opened their door and found Erik face-to-face.

Several hundred homes were visited by Erik and staff members. Afterward, we enjoyed pizza and comradery before heading home.

A fun day was had by all! If you'd like to join the fun, read about volunteer opportunities with this button:

|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas and becoming energy independent. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons, or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professionals, friends and neighbors.

#

We want to give you a quick update on some of the important developments in North Carolina’s Senate race.
A month ago, Donald Trump flew into North Carolina for a rally with Ted Budd and Madison Cawthorn. They made clear that they were in lock-step on a far-right agenda, and Trump took aim at our campaign to make clear that beating us was one of his top priorities this year.

Hi Peter,

**What happens during the June 7th primary will have implications, not just here in CA-27, but for the entire 2022 midterm elections and beyond.**

In just 27 days, I'll be going head-to-head with Mike Garcia during our primary -- and the polls are showing that we're neck-and-neck.

In our deeply polarized nation, there are very few swing districts, but CA-27 is one of them. That means voters here could decide what party controls Congress -- and more importantly -- what kind of future is in store for the country. ## May 10, 2022
---
| |
---
|
# It's the Home Stretch!
---
|
---
| | |
# My family and I watched the Kentucky Derby together yesterday. The winner (Rich Strike) had 80 to 1 odds, the worst odds of all 20 horses. That horse had dirt caked onto its forehead and chest because he was eating the dust kicked up by his competitors.
##

##
## The favored horse (Epicenter) was leading, and had a clean shot to the finish line. You can see in this incredible moment the contrast between them as Rich Strike takes the lead.
##

##
## Sometimes in life you gotta eat a lot of other peoples dust. But when you have a fire in your belly, you push through. This beautiful animals grit and determination has given me the fuel I need for the next 7 days. We're going down the last stretch. All eyes on May 17th. I will push harder than ever before to honor my Mothers legacy.
## I Love and miss you.

---
**Now, it will be up to Governors across the country to keep abortion safe and legal.**
---
**I just set an emergency goal of $50,000 to defeat my anti-choice opponents and safeguard reproductive rights – but I need your help.**
---
**[Please, will you rush $5 right now to help me reach my midnight goal and keep abortion safe and legal?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45202337/344905281/-1540418300?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1289-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODI3MTM4Yi03OGQxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dSaAgp3Jz8hiKTwSlX4FRNhWxKIpE2SNZxxdTvNGtY0=)**

Peter,

Earlier today, every single Republican in the U.S. Senate voted against reproductive freedom – and now, states across the country will be able to ban abortion when the Supreme Court overturns Roe v. Wade.
**In the face of such devastating news, I want you to hear this directly from me: As long as I am in office, I will never allow far-right politicians to take away your right to make decisions about your own body.**
As soon as the Supreme Court's decision is finalized, Republican Governors in Utah, Texas, and Oklahoma will move to ban abortion – and New Mexico will become a lifeline for millions of people searching for reproductive care.
My Republican opponents would like to change that. Every single one of my challengers opposes safe, legal abortion – and if they succeed in replacing me in November on Election Day, New Mexico could outlaw abortion just like our neighbors.
**That's why I'm reaching out to my top supporters during this critical turning point for reproductive rights. I can only keep abortion safe and legal if I win this race, so I need your help to raise $50,000 before midnight and defeat my anti-choice opponents.**
**[Please, will you donate $5 right now to help me win reelection, keep New Mexico blue, and safeguard reproductive freedom?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45202338/344905290/-1540418300?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1289-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODI3MTM4Yi03OGQxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dSaAgp3Jz8hiKTwSlX4FRNhWxKIpE2SNZxxdTvNGtY0=)**
I'll never stop fighting for women's rights. I hope that you'll join me.

Thank you,

Michelle Lujan Grisham

| | Team, This month is Asian American Pacific Islander Heritage Month, a time to celebrate the rich culture and contributions of AAPI communities across our country and state. My family’s story is an immigrant one, spanning multiple generations. It’s a story that binds me — in purpose, pride, and joy — to other immigrants and AAPI Bay Staters. Growing up as a multi-racial child, I became accustomed to moving between worlds, and that experience is one I carry with me today as an AAPI candidate for Governor. But with rising violence continuing to target the AAPI community, it’s clear we need elected officials who will lead the fight against racism and act with urgency to win real change for our communities for the long term. clean_body: My family’s story is an immigrant one, spanning multiple generations. | | | | | Team, This month is Asian American Pacific Islander Heritage Month, a time to celebrate the rich culture and contributions of AAPI communities across our country and state. My family’s story is an immigrant one, spanning multiple generations. It’s a story that binds me — in purpose, pride, and joy — to other immigrants and AAPI Bay Staters. Growing up as a multi-racial child, I became accustomed to moving between worlds, and that experience is one I carry with me today as an AAPI candidate for Governor. But with rising violence continuing to target the AAPI community, it’s clear we need elected officials who will lead the fight against racism and act with urgency to win real change for our communities for the long term. = As the first Asian American State Senator in Massachusetts, this fight is personal. ## South Bay Republican Assembly News
---
|
---
# **South Bay CRA News**
**Special announcement!**
We have 3 Amazing events coming up. We are dedicated to keeping our area deeply rooted in the fight for our State and Nation. Let me know if you have any ideas moving forward or if you would want to participate with us on the front lines.
**Remember our club meets the 4th Monday of every month.**
Blessed and Free
**Nena Gates**
President
nenarenae2@gmail.com
## May 19th Meet & Greet with Derrick Gates
---
---
|
---
# May 19th Meet and Greet with CRA Endorsed Congressional Candidate for the 36th District (former 33rd) Derrick Gates and several other exciting speakers. Come get some great food and find out how you can help save California and the Nation. 7pm Pyramid Office & Medical Park 22939 Hawthorne Blvd, Torrance
[CLICK TO LEARN MORE ABOUT DERRICK](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=21158.32.1.4873fc6f0cbe106f858018574457b07d)
## May 20th LA County-wide CRA candidate Forum.
---
**This will be an incredible night with our future leaders in California and the Nation. Come with your questions and an attitude to help change the Nation. 7pm Pyramid Office & Medical Park 22939 Hawthorne Blvd, Torrance**
---
|
---
# **Cordie Williams for US Senate**
Dr. Cordie Williams is a former United States Marine and has built a successful chiropractic business in San Diego County with his wife Dr. Tania Williams. Dr. Williams co-founded an organization as an expression of his desire to protect Californians’ right to make important decisions for themselves and their families due to the pandemic eroding freedom to make individual choices. Therefore, the time is now to elect leaders who have more faith in the citizenry than in government.
Cordie Williams will be challenging controversial appointed incumbent Alex Padilla in the June 2022 Open California Primary Election. Vice President Kamala Harris held the seat prior to the 2020 election.
[Click to visit Cordie website](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=21158.33.1.59d29b14d85610330ba82e9c102c6a56)
|
---
# **Jenny Rae Le Roux for CA Governor**
Jenny Rae is an accomplished business owner, author, and strategic advisor with a B.A. in Economics from the University of Virginia and an MBA from Columbia Business School.Jenny Rae co-built tech companies in the energy and financial services industries before purchasing Management Consulted, a private tech-enabled services company. She knows the limitations our state has placed on the American Dream – and she’s ready for us to do better.
Jenny Rae is a frequent presenter at Harvard Business School, the Wharton School of Business, and over 60 other top institutions, and has been quoted in Forbes, Business Insider, and other business publications. [Click to Learn more](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=21158.34.1.532ad2fa6cbd1cda4142450aa74e4235)
|
---
# Derrick Gates for US Congress CA-36
Derrick has 15 years of experience in corporate mediation, revitalizing churches, starting ministries, equipping leaders, and helping the less fortunate around the United States.
Derrick has conservative values and an ability to see them reestablished in our communities.
Derrick Mentors multicultural leaders from around the United States.
Derrick desires to raise Bold, Moral, Men, and Women of Integrity to lead our country. [Learn More](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=21158.35.1.d5d9321660ec5e9d5e6f219e7956e7b1)
|
---
# Eric Early for CA Attorney General
Eric Early is a husband, father, small businessman and attorney who is running for California Attorney General in 2022.
In the 2020 election cycle, Eric came in the top two in the June 2020 Primary, becoming the official Republican candidate against Adam Schiff for Congress for California’s 28th Congressional District. His great campaign was fueled by thousands of volunteers and supporters from around the country. Before that, in the 2018 election cycle, Eric entered his first campaign for public office running against Xavier Becerra for California Attorney General and received almost 1 million votes statewide.
Eric is the co-owner and Managing Partner of a 25 lawyer nationally recognized law firm which litigates in courts throughout America, handling constitutional, contract, fraud, real estate and general business disputes. [Learn More](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=21158.36.1.f2757eb376b453c516507cb48a78bc19)
|
---
# Jack M. Guerrero CA Treasurer
Jack Guerrero brings a unique combination of public and private sector experience, with a quintessential American story. Jack’s experience as Mayor, City Councilmember, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Stanford economics graduate, Harvard MBA, Bank Vice President, Treasury professional, auditor of municipalities and government agencies, investment banker, and M&A due diligence advisor to Fortune 500 companies (with professional stints in New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, London, and Zurich) – establishes him as the candidate with BOTH Treasury experience AND a public service record of fighting for taxpayers and working people. [Learn More](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=21158.37.1.c7743f26ea1a1cdc10784b21d7e49d41)
|
---
# JOIN THE SBCRA TODAY
**On the 23rd** we have our Monthly South Bay Republican Assembly Meeting. We have some exciting speakers lined up That will be announced next week. We meet currently at the Walteria Business Club 24004 Neece Ave, Torrance, CA 6:30 pm
**Correction from our last Newsletter:**
**I mistakenly said that we meet on the last Monday of every month and it is the 4th Monday of every month. And currently, we meet at the Walteria Business Club 24004 Neece Ave, Torrance, CA 6:30 pmI apologize for the confusion**
If you want to Join the fight, you can get started at this link!
[CLICK TO JOIN THE SOUTH BAY CRA](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=21158.38.1.18dc471fe891c325f81fca10d98c187a)
---

Peter, I want to talk for a moment with you about immigration. Will you give me the courtesy of reading this email?

When hateful MAGA Republicans talk about immigration issues, they always neglect the harder conversation of __why these people risk everything to cross the border.__

Instead, they amplify hateful and racist rhetoric to scare voters. It's utterly sickening when I dwell on some of the things they say and believe about immigrants — _I'm sure you feel the same way._

But here's the truth: Commonly, South and Central Americans flee to avoid extreme poverty, gang violence, or harsh political persecution. _But one often forgotten group is LGBTQ migrants._

**Last Friday, I traveled to Tijuana, Mexico, to learn about this unique group of migrants and their challenges.**

Along with the rest of their fellow migrants, they travel thousands of miles by foot to flee anti-LGBTQ discrimination and violence in search of a better future here in America.

Peter, as a progressive gay man of color, I’m uniquely able to understand how these marginalized identities often face distinct challenging obstacles. _**That’s why I’m fighting to get these people the support and resources they desperately need.**_

body:
Peter,
Normally, a strategy email like this one would only go to major stakeholders and large donors, but we’re running a different kind of campaign here, so I want to send it to all of you.
Here’s the internal strategy memo we sent out last week:
To: Interested Parties
From: Matthew Van Name, Strategic Manager for Nikki Fried
Date: May 4, 2022
A Clear Pathway: The Favorite Candidate with the Right Message.
As people are just beginning to tune into the Democratic Primary for Governor, we commissioned a Public Policy Poll (A- rated by 538) to know where we stand. This benchmark shows we’re in a very good place.
Nikki is +35 favorability — the most popular candidate in the race.
Charlie is +28 but, almost disqualifying, he is underwater (viewed more negatively than positively) among voters under 45 years old (-4) and Latino voters (-5). These are likely Democratic primary voters not just saying they won’t vote for Charlie in the primary, they are actually saying they find him unfavorable.
If you’ve followed Florida long, you know both of those demographics are critical to closing the margin in a general election. We can’t afford to nominate someone even remotely negative in these demographics.
Conversely, Nikki is +40 among 18-45 year olds and +25 among Latino voters.
When it comes to the head-to-head, this poll included both text and landlines. Landlines tend to skew heavily older, and this is the demographic where Nikki needs the most work. While the 65+ voters who know Nikki view her just as favorably as Charlie Crist (+31), a full 51% of senior citizens can’t rate her at all. So when we force a head-to-head decision, that shows in the numbers, which look like this:
Via text: Fried: 46%, Crist: 35%, Not sure: 19%
Via landline: Fried: 28%, Crist: 54%, Not Sure: 17%
*There is also a third candidate in the race, State Senator Annettee Taddeo, but she is virtually unknown to likely Democratic primary voters, and polls so low we don’t believe it’s statistically significant to include in a head-to-head, (for example, this poll has her favorability underwater among Latino voters (-6)).
Importantly, we believe this race is essentially tied right now.
More importantly, we believe that if we hit even our lowest level of budget, we will have enough money to communicate about Nikki to the demographics where we need the most work, senior and Black voters, and run away with this primary with a huge amount of “underdog” momentum into the general election.
We also have the benefit of running on a message that can actually win in November. We’ve seen our opponent make a number of recent mistakes that would be huge liabilities — calling DeSantis voters “toothless,” using COVID-19 proxy voting to skip work, and campaigning on a Nancy Pelosi endorsement.
Meanwhile, Nikki is campaigning on lowering the cost of living and raising the standard of life.
This is a message that we know is resonating — not just with Democrats, but with the critical and growing block of Non-Party-Affiliated voters we need to win, and never-Trump Republicans sick of culture wars.
This is our primary and general to win.
Nikki has the momentum, the message, and the mass appeal to defeat Ron DeSantis and win this race. Now, we just need the grassroots support and enthusiasm to put our strategy into motion. Can you chip in $20 to help us out? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-may-2022?refcode=510memo]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-may-2022?refcode=510memo]
Thank you for being on our team.
— Matthew Van Name

It's up to us to provide Summer the last minute grassroots boost she needs to combat $3 million in attack ads.
#
Peter, establishment Super PACs have now spent more than $3 million to defeat Summer Lee. It’s so much money, that 75%(!) of all spending for Summer’s corporate Democrat opponent is from Super PACs.

clean_body: We are a week out from the first votes | | | Dear Team, In 8 days, the first voters in IL-7 will make their choice. Next week, mail ballots will arrive and the first early vote sites will open. The question that is haunting me today is: Will enough voters know what is at stake in this primary? From gun violence to the gutting of reproductive rights, our communities are suffering, and there is nobody fighting for IL-7 at the federal level. This primary election is about changing that forever. It is urgent and it is possible. In order to make sure voters know exactly what their choice is before the vote, we need to make sure we are contacting them by every means necessary. That means knocking doors, making calls, distributing literature, sending mailers and all of that costs thousands of dollars. Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [Newsom's Fit of Spite](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziopF5q-IVqwsX1fe-OqRtqBxEwCQ8U3bsOXoLxLuaUyqXQ&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may11_final&n=1) Gavin Newsom is still trying to punish businesses that stayed open during lockdowns and is specifically targeting political opponents. Even his media allies are disturbed. A Sacramento Bee headline reads: “Roseville restaurant that hosted ‘Newsom hour’ facing 30-day closure over COVID order.” The story continues: _"A Roseville restaurant that provocatively defied one of Gov. Gavin Newsom’s coronavirus emergency orders is fighting a potentially crippling suspension...__Matthew Oliver, the restaurant owner, recently learned the [ABC] agency still wants to shut the House of Oliver. The notice came after The Bee featured him in a news story about how Placer County managed Newsom’s public health orders, often by ignoring state directives."_ I’ve just sent Newsom and ABC [a letter](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=T5He9HRd2mnp6QN0SYKMHEGgI-Mi0Nowc5mws1asme-cGpsTB9w5tuCOD6oZ19KFDWMrtyMYbsdi_FpwFViOVNhE35sw2PbOBCIlyDRZjQDvwtQQEEmWMjIhvnMaI06GRhyBvtjH6j-TDxhmuKJ_uDkRj9sLvn7Zv0R_aIZrYWaFy2cKACaeua9DIR4h7jmZ&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may11_final&n=2) demanding the proceeding against House of Oliver __ end immediately, calling it “politically motivated” and a “selective prosecution.” Last year, incidentally, I authored legislation to wipe clean all license revocations and fines for noncompliance with COVID orders. The bill had bipartisan support and was about to pass when leadership intervened, killing it on a 6-7 vote. Newsom could never justify lockdowns, so he simply ordered them by fiat. In the same way, trying to close Matt Oliver’s business (which employees 100 people) is not just petty and vindictive, but a flagrant abuse of power. If Newsom doesn’t back down, he’ll be shot down in court. In the meantime, if you’re in the Sacramento area, join me and Matt at House of Oliver today after 5 for a revived “Newsom Hour.” Kevin Kiley
California Legislator p.s. Ballots are out! If you want me to be able to keep fighting for California, and to take on Biden like I have Newsom, _[please help our campaign get across the finish line](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may11_final&n=3)_.

| Team —

May is Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander Heritage Month, an opportunity to celebrate the cultures and contributions of the AAPI community here in San Diego and across the country.

San Diego is so lucky to have such a vibrant and diverse AAPI community that has done so much to make the San Diego we love. Unfortunately, in the past two years, we have seen a disturbing rise in anti-Asian violence across the country. It is more important than ever to denounce this hate and work to dismantle racism in all forms. But we don’t only want to talk about the negative and the hatred when it comes to the Asian-American experience. We also need to celebrate the culture and vibrancy and resilience of this community.

So this month, let’s all recommit ourselves to creating a fairer, more just inclusive society for us all as we honor the contributions and amplify the stories of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders. I look forward to working alongside you as we do.

Thank you,
Sara

clean_body: San Diego is so lucky to have such a vibrant and diverse AAPI community that has done so much to make the San Diego we love. | = | Team — May is Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander Heritage Month, an opportunity to celebrate the cultures and contributions of the AAPI community here in San Diego and across the country. San Diego is so lucky to have such a vibrant and diverse AAPI community that has done so much to make the San Diego we love. Unfortunately, in the past two years, we have seen a disturbing rise in anti-Asian violence across the country. It is more important than ever to denounce this hate and work to dismantle racism in all forms. But we don’t only want to talk about the negative and the hatred when it comes to the Asian-American experience. We also need to celebrate the culture and vibrancy and resilience of this community. So this month, let’s all recommit ourselves to creating a fairer, more just inclusive society for us all as we honor the contributions and amplify the stories of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders. I look forward to working alongside you as we do. I’m losing patience, folks. A 50/50 Senate isn’t just not
cutting it—it’s dangerous.

Moments ago, the Senate failed to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act,
which would codify Roe v. Wade. Thanks to Senate Republicans abusing the
filibuster once again, right-wing politicians in states across the
country—including Ohio—will ban abortion when Roe is officially overturned
next month.

I’m angry, scared for my children, and tired of this bullshit. It has
never been more important to win this race and expand the Democratic
Senate majority. It’s the only way forward.

I’m pissed off that the government thinks it’s their place to force us to have birth and saddle us with thousands of dollars of medical debt while stripping us of healthcare.
**There is no room in the Democratic Party for bigoted, anti-choice politicians—and there is no more room to coddle these hateful views as our rights get ripped out from under us. If they think we’re just going to roll over and not fight back, they have another thing coming.**

#
Peter, Republicans in the Senate just filibustered urgently needed legislation to protect abortion rights. Again.
No matter how many times the Senate considers the Women’s Health Protection Act, a bill to codify _Roe v. Wade_ , the outcome will NOT change until we do something about it. Republicans are implementing extreme abortion restrictions in states across the country, so why would they suddenly join us to codify _Roe_?
Let’s be very clear: it’s the filibuster or our abortion rights. The same thing keeps happening on voting rights, LGBTQIA+ rights, and much more. We must respond by getting rid of the filibuster to take power away from Mitch McConnell, protect abortion rights, and do what the people sent us to Congress to do.
[**Peter, are you with me? Join me in this fight to end the filibuster by chipping in $3 or more right now. Abortion rights, voting rights, and so much more continue to be on the line. We have to act.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13628?refcode=em20220511-1254&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1254%2E420207%2EUGhRBZ)

Republicans across the country have passed extreme abortion restrictions at the state level. Even more states will immediately see abortion access restricted and criminalized if SCOTUS issues a final opinion overturning _Roe_.

**Peter, we must nix the filibuster and deliver for the people.**

Pramila

clean_body: It Was a Heck of a Couple Months | | ---|---|--- | | It Was a Heck of a Couple Months | | May 11| | | ---|---|---|--- I wanted to say thank you!!! It was a heck of a couple of months. I can't even begin to name all the amazing ppl that supported the campaign and whom we've gotten to know. | | ---|---|--- Besides my family, I have to first mention Tyson Kinzle. He is a dear friend and was the lynchpin of the whole campaign. It was just him and I steering the ship but he was solely responsible for the website, all social media, and graphics/logos. From the start of the campaign, his vision validated it all! He was born for the marketing role and his talent is unmatched. If anyone you know is looking for some assistance in terms of marketing, he is your man. He owns his own company, . Please check it out!! | | ---|---|--- To my family, friends, coworkers, etc... I love you all tons. The calls, texts, emails, etc. of support, I'll never forget. It was a tough go trying to manage family obligations, full-time employment( was outstanding), and run the campaign but we pulled through!! To the people that voted for us... I can't thank you enough for putting your trust in me. It was absolutely humbling and not taken lightly. To the groups and individuals who endorsed us and volunteered... thank you, thank you, thank you! | | ---|---|--- It wasn't the result we wanted but that's ok. We jumped in this race for the right reasons and with the best intentions, we gave it a go. No regrets!! To my wife and kids... thank you and I can't love the 4 of you anymore!! It's not fun losing but there are many bright spots. One is, that I got a couple of calls this morning that we might have set a congressional primary record for most votes with the least amount of money. This means all your donations were amazing and were put to great use! We got 15,000 votes (almost 25%) and you all donated $10,000. My understanding is that 66 cents per vote is unheard of, considering we were up against millions of dollars. That's a win in our book!!! God Bless, love ya, and thank you all!! | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- If you support , please give here. (C) 2022 Steve Kuehl 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104

##
Bill McSwain for Governor: 6 Days to go, how you can help us WIN!
May 11, 2022 Good evening, McSwain supporters!
Thank you for your continued support of Bill McSwain for Governor of Pennsylvania.

With only 6 days left until the Primary Election, our campaign is working diligently to secure a McSwain victory- but we need help from all of our supporters as well! We have had many people reach out and ask how they can help!
---
| Please spread the word to your family, friends, neighbors, and colleagues about why Bill McSwain is the best candidate for Governor. An endorsement from a trusted voice (you!) is the best way to help your community choose their candidate! Additionally, please consider strengthening your support in the following ways: 1\. Place a yard sign on your property, and around your community. Please email derek@billmcswain.com if you would like one. 2\. Come out this Saturday 05/14 to help door knock in Chester County. We will be gathering at the Chester County Republican Committee HQ (15 S Church Street, West Chester, PA) at 9:00 AM and will knock on doors from 10:00 AM-2:00 PM, or earlier if there is rain. Please let me know if you can make it!

2\. Volunteer to help at a polling location on Election Day (Tuesday, May 17). We would love to have an abundance of McSwain signs, stickers, and happy warriors passing out Bill’s information at the polls! Again, please email me if you would like to help. 3\. Send a brief email to your networks encouraging people to vote for your pick for Governor, Bill McSwain. A personal recommendation goes far! See [Bill’s website](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=bc6df9a282&e=b1ec95759b) for his talking points and bio.

4\. A financial contribution to the Campaign so we can maximize our outreach efforts in this final week. You can do that [here](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=d3385e003c&e=b1ec95759b)!

A Primary Election victory is only possible with help from great citizens, such as yourself.

Now, let’s go win this! Thank you,

Derek Rockey
Field Director
Bill McSwain for Governor
717-706-2719

Derek,
With the Supreme Court poised to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ , the Senate just failed to pass a bill to protect abortion rights.

subject: It failed. Here’s what we do now (re: reproductive rights)
