body:
If we want to protect a woman's right to choose, then we must elect Beto as the next Governor of Texas.
#
There is no cavalry coming to save us. **We've got to win this race.**
A bill to enshrine _Roe v. Wade_ into federal law was just defeated in the Senate. The Women’s Health Protection Act failed to get the votes necessary to pass.
It’s crystal clear that the Supreme Court won't save abortion rights and Congress won't either, so it's up to all of us. If we want to protect a woman's right to choose, then we must elect Beto as the next Governor of Texas.
[**If you're with Beto in this fight, please pitch in $3 or more _immediately_ to unseat Greg Abbott and elect Beto. We must win in Texas to protect reproductive rights for people across the state.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220511-1?refcode=ema20220511-188876&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&refcode2=188876_444211_s1Nfo5&akid=188876%2E444211%2Es1Nfo5)

Greg Abbott has repeatedly rolled back the rights of Texans — their rights to vote, to control their own bodies, and so much more. But the Senate has failed to end the filibuster and take the action that’s necessary to fight back.
We can't count on anyone but ourselves. That's why we're building the biggest organizing team in Texas history to elect a Governor who will fight for reproductive freedom. On Saturday alone, we knocked on 10,384 doors across Texas and made 112,053 phone calls so we could speak directly to Texans about what's at stake.
It’s frustrating to see the Senate and Supreme Court let us down with so much on the line. **But if we work together and turn our despair into action, we will win on November 8 and elect a pro-choice Governor for the state of Texas.**
[**Please, make a $3 donation right now to help elect Beto and defeat anti-choice Greg Abbott in November.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220511-1?refcode=ema20220511-188876&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&refcode2=188876_444211_s1Nfo5&akid=188876%2E444211%2Es1Nfo5)

Peter,

I have never changed. My mission has never changed. I work every day to deliver results for Alaskans and Americans.

It is what I was elected to do. And I would be honored if they gave me the opportunity to represent them for six more years.

But, I've never been in a race like this, Peter.

Some people might say "It's time for an absolute, down-the-line, always, always, 100-percent, never-question, rubber-stamp radical politician."

But I don't think that's what most Alaskans want. Alaskans deserve a choice.

# [U.S. Spends $800k to Study if its $2 Mil Salvadoran Youth Violence Prevention Initiative is Effective](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58859&L=27340&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdS1zLXNwZW5kcy04MDBrLW9uLXN0dWR5Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNvcnJ1cHRpb24rY2hyb25pY2xlcyZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz)
Less than a year after the government dedicated millions of dollars to study if its costly decade-old Latin American gang prevention initiative is effective, it will spend another $800,000 to research if a similar taxpayer-funded program is working in El Salvador. The new probe will focus on the Police Athletic League (PAL) youth outreach program, which Uncle Sam has funded in the impoverished Central American country to the tune of $2 million. The money flows through the Bureau of International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs (INL), a State Department offshoot created in the late 70s to reduce drug trafficking into the U.S. from Latin America.

**“Democrats face worsening legal environment on redistricting”**
– _Associated Press_ Folks,

We may have made a lot of progress in the fight against gerrymandering, but our battle isn’t over yet — not even close! First we learned that Republicans who are upset that state courts have knocked down so many of their manipulated maps are now trying to stack those very same courts.

Plus, AP reports that “**Republicans are favored to win** state supreme court races in North Carolina and Ohio in November that’d enable those GOP-controlled legislatures to implement more partisan maps before 2024.” We can’t allow this! **_[Pitch in to help the NDRC fight back!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45205656/344944709/-160273206?amount=20&refcode=20220511.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY2YmYwZmJmLWExZDEtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ccplt0KlBo3jZRYfPwUwLrOADmnzHCnf_tO63ATFsbg=)_**

**State Representative Doyle Heffley endorses Barletta for Governor**
---
Former mayor and congressman Lou Barletta, leading Republican candidate for governor of Pennsylvania, today announced the formal endorsement of State Representative Doyle Heffley (R-Carbon). Heffley joins a growing number of state representatives endorsing Barletta's surging campaign including: State Rep. John Fritz, State Rep. Barb Gleim, State Rep. Sue Helm, State Rep. David Millard, State Rep. Jack Rader, State Rep. Aaron Kaufer, and State Rep. Karen Boback.
“I’ve known Lou Barletta since he was mayor of Hazleton, so I have seen him fight for the people of Pennsylvania," said **Representative Doyle Heffley.** "Gov. Wolf has left the state a mess and Josh Shapiro would only make it worse, so we must have a fighter to restore sanity to the governor’s office. I wholeheartedly endorse Lou Barletta and encourage all Republicans to support him as the candidate who will win in November.”

clean_body: Friends, I understand the most critical issues facing Missourians because I can feel the impacts of destructive leadership on my own life. The rising cost of healthcare, the cost of energy, the health of our democracy, and the fight for a fair workplace are impacting all of us. I am running for Congress because I believe Missourians deserve a leader who understands the very real issues that we are dealing with. Democracy is under threat by far-right extremists. We need someone willing to condemn the events of January 6th, 2021, and work to protect voting rights. The future of our city, state, and country are on the ballot this November, and I think YOU deserve better, more compassionate, and effective leadership than Ann Wagner. Will you contribute and help me win this? [] You can count on me to properly represent you because I know that: I am running to unseat Ann Wagner because she has been in politics for 30 years and she has done NOTHING to deliver for the people she represents. Every day Americans should not need to spend their entire paycheck seeing a doctor. We need to act quickly to uphold the will of the voters by expanding Medicaid, capping the price of insulin, and providing accessible healthcare to everyone. Renewable Energy independence is the key to making sure Americans don’t suffer at the gas pump. When I am in Congress, I will work to make St. Louis a center for innovation and technology, bringing jobs to our communities and fighting the climate crisis in the process. * We need to fight corruption and work for the people , by getting dark money out of politics and making sure politicians can’t draw their own districts. We will not give up now, or ever.
| | | Friend,

I just got off the Senate floor, and I’m livid. Every single Republican just voted against the Women’s Health Protection Act.

This bill would have protected the right to choose, even if _Roe v. Wade_ is overturned – an absolute necessity after the Supreme Court’s abominable draft decision overturning _Roe_ was leaked last week.

**Let me be clear: We will not give up now, or ever, in the fight to protect the right to choose.** And now, every American can see where every senator stands. Republicans can no longer hide behind their lies. They are officially on the record opposing a right that Americans support by a two-to-one margin.

But make no mistake: if Republicans take back the Senate, they will try to pass a nationwide abortion ban. Choice should not be up to a handful of right-wing justices. Choice should not be up to a handful of right-wing politicians.
